tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you haven't hit your 3-stars yet, you must roll until you hit them. you should level to 6 after hitting. in some rare games, you will miss or spend so much gold you can never catch up. these games will usually result in bottom 4 placements.
tasks.en: If you haven't hit your 3-stars yet, you must roll until you hit them. You should level to 6 after hitting. In some rare games, you will miss or spend so much gold you can never catch up. These games will usually result in bottom 4 placements.
tasks.vi: Nếu chưa có tướng 3 sao, hãy tiếp tục roll cho đến khi đạt được. Sau đó lên cấp 6. Đôi khi bạn sẽ roll mãi không ra hoặc tiêu quá nhiều vàng đến mức không thể bắt kịp nhịp trận đấu; những ván như vậy thường kết thúc ở nhóm 4 vị trí cuối.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you can stay above ~20g. otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you can stay above ~20g. Otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7 nếu vẫn giữ được khoảng 20 vàng trở lên; nếu không, ở lại cấp 6.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8 if you are in bottom half of lobby hp and are losing rounds. if you are higher hp and feel stable, you can wait until next turn.
tasks.en: Level to 8 if you are in bottom half of lobby HP and are losing rounds. If you are higher HP and feel stable, you can wait until next turn.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8 nếu lượng máu của bạn thuộc nửa dưới sảnh đấu và đang thua liên tục. Nếu còn nhiều máu và đội hình đã ổn định, bạn có thể chờ đến vòng sau.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8 if you haven't already. roll for any remaining units necessary for the comp. if stable, you can try to go 9. most games you will end on level 8.
tasks.en: Level to 8 if you haven't already. Roll for any remaining units necessary for the comp. If stable, you can try to go 9. Most games you will end on level 8.
tasks.vi: Nếu chưa lên cấp 8 thì hãy lên ngay. Roll tìm những tướng quan trọng còn thiếu cho đội hình. Khi đội hình đã ổn định, bạn có thể cân nhắc lên cấp 9; phần lớn ván đấu sẽ kết thúc ở cấp 8.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 9 whenever possible. this is rare, but can happen in the games you have a chance of winning.
tasks.en: Level to 9 whenever possible. This is rare, but can happen in the games you have a chance of winning.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 9 bất cứ khi nào có thể. Cơ hội này không thường xuyên, nhưng có thể xuất hiện trong những ván bạn đủ khả năng tranh top 1.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 4 if you have upgrades and a good item to place on one of those upgrades.
tasks.en: Level to 4 if you have upgrades and a good item to place on one of those upgrades.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 4 nếu bạn đã nâng cấp được tướng và có trang bị tốt để ghép cho một trong số đó.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 5, unless on 3 loss streak.
tasks.en: Level to 5, unless on 3 loss streak.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 5, trừ khi bạn đang có chuỗi thua 3 vòng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 6. roll until stable. "stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch, but generally it involves 2-starring your desired 2-cost carry and a tank with items. major divergence between elos: the lower your elo, the less upgrades you need to be "stable" and thus lower elo players should generally roll less than high elo players on 3-2.
tasks.en: Level to 6. Roll until stable. "Stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch, but generally it involves 2-starring your desired 2-cost carry and a tank with items. Major divergence between elos: The lower your elo, the less upgrades you need to be "stable" and thus lower elo players should generally roll less than high elo players on 3-2.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 6 rồi roll đến khi đội hình đủ ổn định. Khái niệm “ổn định” còn tùy bậc xếp hạng, trang bị, Nâng Cấp, đội hình và bản cập nhật; thông thường, bạn cần chủ lực 2 vàng dự định chơi lên 2 sao cùng một tướng chống chịu đã có trang bị. Điểm khác biệt lớn giữa các mức rank: rank càng thấp thì càng cần ít nâng cấp để ổn định, vì vậy người chơi rank thấp thường nên roll ít hơn người chơi rank cao ở vòng 3-2.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::after your 3-2 rolldown, you should attempt to rebuild your economy to 50g.
tasks.en: After your 3-2 rolldown, you should attempt to rebuild your economy to 50g.
tasks.vi: Sau đợt roll mạnh ở vòng 3-2, hãy cố gắng tích lại 50 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::once you reach 50g (it might be later than 3-5), start slow rolling down to ~52g each turn. try to avoid rolling to exactly 50g as any unit you want to buy in shop will put you below 50g.
tasks.en: Once you reach 50g (it might be later than 3-5), start slow rolling down to ~52g each turn. Try to avoid rolling to exactly 50g as any unit you want to buy in shop will put you below 50g.
tasks.vi: Khi đạt 50 vàng (có thể muộn hơn vòng 3-5), hãy bắt đầu slow roll, mỗi vòng chỉ tiêu xuống khoảng 52 vàng. Tránh roll đúng mốc 50 vàng vì mua bất kỳ tướng nào trong cửa hàng cũng khiến bạn tụt xuống dưới mốc lợi tức.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you are high hp relative to the lobby, continue slow rolling to 52g each turn. if you are lower hp, you should roll to hit your first 2-cost 3 star on 4-1 or 4-2. if you have to roll below 30g, your placement is usually capped at 3rd or 4th.
tasks.en: If you are high HP relative to the lobby, continue slow rolling to 52g each turn. If you are lower HP, you should roll to hit your first 2-cost 3 star on 4-1 or 4-2. If you have to roll below 30g, your placement is usually capped at 3rd or 4th.
tasks.vi: Nếu lượng máu của bạn cao so với cả sảnh, tiếp tục slow roll và giữ khoảng 52 vàng mỗi vòng. Nếu máu thấp hơn, hãy roll để tìm tướng 2 vàng 3 sao đầu tiên ở vòng 4-1 hoặc 4-2. Nếu phải roll xuống dưới 30 vàng, thứ hạng thường chỉ có thể dừng ở top 3 hoặc top 4.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you are still high hp (70+), you can continue to slow roll. otherwise, in the majority of cases, you should roll deep for your 3-stars here. if your hp is low, you can even go to 0 gold looking for your 3-stars. if you have your 3-stars and can afford to level to 7 with 10g+, do so.
tasks.en: If you are still high HP (70+), you can continue to slow roll. Otherwise, in the majority of cases, you should roll deep for your 3-stars here. If your HP is low, you can even go to 0 gold looking for your 3-stars. If you have your 3-stars and can afford to level to 7 with 10g+, do so.
tasks.vi: Nếu vẫn còn nhiều máu (trên 70), bạn có thể tiếp tục slow roll. Nếu không, trong đa số trường hợp hãy roll sâu để tìm tướng 3 sao ở vòng này. Khi máu thấp, thậm chí có thể roll hết về 0 vàng. Nếu đã có các tướng 3 sao và vẫn có thể lên cấp 7 với ít nhất 10 vàng, hãy lên cấp.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you haven't already.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you haven't already.
tasks.vi: Nếu chưa lên cấp 7, hãy lên ngay.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8 as soon as possible. this may not happen until 5-5 or in some games, stage 6.
tasks.en: Level to 8 as soon as possible. This may not happen until 5-5 or in some games, stage 6.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8 sớm nhất có thể. Có ván bạn phải chờ đến vòng 5-5, thậm chí sang Giai đoạn 6 mới làm được.
Lên cấp 4 nếu đội hình đang mạnh.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 6, unless it places you below 30g.
tasks.en: Level to 6, unless it places you below 30g.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 6, trừ khi việc đó khiến bạn còn dưới 30 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::stay level 6, unless you can stay above 50g on 7 or you are below 40 hp and can stay above 30g on 7.
tasks.en: Stay level 6, unless you can stay above 50g on 7 or you are below 40 HP and can stay above 30g on 7.
tasks.vi: Giữ cấp 6, trừ khi bạn có thể lên cấp 7 mà vẫn giữ trên 50 vàng, hoặc khi máu dưới 40 và vẫn giữ được trên 30 vàng sau khi lên cấp 7.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7, roll until board mostly upgraded. never go below 10g even if missing tank or carry.
tasks.en: Level to 7, roll until board mostly upgraded. Never go below 10g even if missing tank or carry.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7 rồi roll cho đến khi phần lớn đội hình được nâng cấp. Đừng roll xuống dưới 10 vàng, kể cả khi còn thiếu chủ lực hoặc chống chịu.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::build up to 50g, slow roll to 50g until 5-1.
tasks.en: Build up to 50g, slow roll to 50g until 5-1.
tasks.vi: Tích lên 50 vàng, sau đó slow roll quanh mốc này cho đến vòng 5-1.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if below ~25 hp, sometimes you must roll until you hit here. not ideal.
tasks.en: If below ~25 HP, sometimes you must roll until you hit here. Not ideal.
tasks.vi: Nếu còn dưới khoảng 25 máu, đôi khi bạn buộc phải roll đến khi ra tướng ở vòng này. Đây không phải tình huống lý tưởng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::roll until you hit 3-star carry and tank. can go to 0g. only greed gold if you are above ~60 hp.
tasks.en: Roll until you hit 3-star carry and tank. Can go to 0g. Only greed gold if you are above ~60 HP.
tasks.vi: Roll cho đến khi chủ lực và tướng chống chịu lên 3 sao; có thể tiêu hết về 0 vàng. Chỉ nên tham giữ vàng nếu bạn còn trên khoảng 60 máu.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you hit, you can level to 8. otherwise stay 7. holds true for every round for the rest of the game.
tasks.en: If you hit, you can level to 8. Otherwise stay 7. Holds true for every round for the rest of the game.
tasks.vi: Nếu đã ra đủ tướng mục tiêu, bạn có thể lên cấp 8; nếu chưa, hãy giữ cấp 7. Nguyên tắc này áp dụng cho mọi vòng còn lại của trận đấu.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 6 if on 4+ win streak (scout to see if necessary in high elo) or can stay above 40g.
tasks.en: Level to 6 if on 4+ win streak (scout to see if necessary in high elo) or can stay above 40g.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 6 nếu đang có chuỗi thắng từ 4 vòng trở lên (ở rank cao, hãy do thám để xem có thực sự cần thiết không) hoặc nếu vẫn giữ được trên 40 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 6, unless you would go below 30g. if you have to stay level 5 due to low gold (rare), then level to 6 on 3-5.
tasks.en: Level to 6, unless you would go below 30g. If you have to stay level 5 due to low gold (rare), then level to 6 on 3-5.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 6, trừ khi bạn sẽ còn dưới 30 vàng. Nếu hiếm khi phải ở cấp 5 vì thiếu vàng, hãy lên cấp 6 ở vòng 3-5.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you can stay above 30g, otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you can stay above 30g, otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7 nếu vẫn giữ được trên 30 vàng; nếu không, ở lại cấp 6.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8. roll for desired comp until stable. "stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch. melee carries and tanks get the biggest spike for 2-stars. usually stable involves 2-star tank or carry and some other supporting 2-stars. try not to roll below 10g.
tasks.en: Level to 8. Roll for desired comp until stable. "Stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch. Melee carries and tanks get the biggest spike for 2-stars. Usually stable involves 2-star tank or carry and some other supporting 2-stars. Try not to roll below 10g.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8. Roll tìm các tướng cần thiết cho đội hình đến khi ổn định. Mức độ ổn định phụ thuộc vào rank, trang bị, Nâng Cấp, đội hình và bản cập nhật. Chủ lực cận chiến và tướng chống chịu thường tăng sức mạnh rõ rệt nhất khi lên 2 sao. Thông thường, đội hình ổn định khi chủ lực hoặc chống chịu đạt 2 sao cùng một vài tướng hỗ trợ 2 sao khác. Cố gắng không roll xuống dưới 10 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you are weak (e.g., have no 2-star 4-costs), consider rolling again to 10g here. if you are stable, save gold to go 9.
tasks.en: If you are weak (e.g., have no 2-star 4-costs), consider rolling again to 10g here. If you are stable, save gold to go 9.
tasks.vi: Nếu đội hình còn yếu (chẳng hạn chưa có tướng 4 vàng nào 2 sao), cân nhắc roll thêm, xuống còn 10 vàng. Nếu đã ổn định, hãy giữ vàng để lên cấp 9.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you are low hp and haven't 2-starred your carry and tank, roll to 0g. if you have medium to high hp with an upgraded + itemized 4-cost unit and some other upgrades, save gold to go 9.
tasks.en: If you are low HP and haven't 2-starred your carry and tank, roll to 0g. If you have medium to high HP with an upgraded + itemized 4-cost unit and some other upgrades, save gold to go 9.
tasks.vi: Nếu máu thấp và chủ lực lẫn chống chịu chưa lên 2 sao, hãy roll hết về 0 vàng. Nếu còn lượng máu trung bình đến cao, có tướng 4 vàng đã lên sao và được trang bị tốt cùng một vài nâng cấp khác, hãy tích vàng để lên cấp 9.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if high hp, consider waiting until 5-5 to go level 9. if medium hp, consider going level 9 if you can roll 20g or wait until 5-5. if low hp and can afford to go 9, do so even if you have almost no gold to roll on 9. if you can't afford to go 9 this game, roll every turn for upgrades.
tasks.en: If high HP, consider waiting until 5-5 to go level 9. If medium HP, consider going level 9 if you can roll 20g or wait until 5-5. If low HP and can afford to go 9, do so even if you have almost no gold to roll on 9. If you can't afford to go 9 this game, roll every turn for upgrades.
tasks.vi: Nếu máu cao, cân nhắc chờ đến vòng 5-5 mới lên cấp 9. Nếu máu ở mức trung bình, hãy lên cấp 9 nếu vẫn có thể giữ 20 vàng để roll, hoặc chờ đến 5-5. Nếu máu thấp và đủ vàng lên cấp 9, hãy lên ngay cả khi gần như không còn vàng để roll. Nếu không thể lên cấp 9 trong ván này, hãy roll mỗi vòng để nâng cấp đội hình.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 9 if possible. from this point onward, look to level to 9. acknowledge games where level 9 is not possible and roll every turn on 8 to preserve placements.
tasks.en: Level to 9 if possible. From this point onward, look to level to 9. Acknowledge games where level 9 is not possible and roll every turn on 8 to preserve placements.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 9 nếu có thể. Từ thời điểm này, hãy hướng đến cấp 9. Nếu ván đấu không cho phép lên cấp 9, hãy chấp nhận điều đó và roll mỗi vòng ở cấp 8 để giữ thứ hạng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::for max cap games, you can either roll on 9 or level to 10. if you are itemizing a 5-cost carry and it is 1-starred, roll on 9. if you have all your main itemized units upgraded, level to 10.
tasks.en: For max cap games, you can either roll on 9 or level to 10. If you are itemizing a 5-cost carry and it is 1-starred, roll on 9. If you have all your main itemized units upgraded, level to 10.
tasks.vi: Khi muốn đẩy sức mạnh đội hình lên tối đa, bạn có thể roll ở cấp 9 hoặc lên cấp 10. Nếu chủ lực 5 vàng đang cầm trang bị mới chỉ 1 sao, hãy tiếp tục roll ở cấp 9. Nếu các tướng chủ lực đã được trang bị đều đã nâng sao, hãy lên cấp 10.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::without econ augment, fast 9 is almost impossible without win-streak.
tasks.en: Without econ augment, fast 9 is almost impossible without win-streak.
tasks.vi: Nếu không có Nâng Cấp kinh tế, chiến thuật lên cấp 9 nhanh gần như không thể thực hiện nếu bạn không có chuỗi thắng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7, or 8 if you can stay above 30g.
tasks.en: Level to 7, or 8 if you can stay above 30g.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7, hoặc cấp 8 nếu vẫn giữ được trên 30 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8. main difference from fast 8 is how much you roll on 8. ideally you are high hp and don't need to roll at all. otherwise, roll for acceptable board and accumulate gold afterward.
tasks.en: Level to 8. Main difference from Fast 8 is how much you roll on 8. Ideally you are high HP and don't need to roll at all. Otherwise, roll for acceptable board and accumulate gold afterward.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8. Khác biệt chính so với chiến thuật lên cấp 8 nhanh là lượng vàng bạn dùng để roll ở cấp 8. Lý tưởng nhất là bạn còn nhiều máu và không cần roll. Nếu không, hãy roll để có đội hình đủ mạnh rồi tích vàng trở lại.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 9 if you are rich enough to roll 40g+. generally only possible with economy augment or encounter.
tasks.en: Level to 9 if you are rich enough to roll 40g+. Generally only possible with economy augment or encounter.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 9 nếu bạn có đủ vàng để vẫn roll được từ 40 vàng trở lên. Điều này thường chỉ khả thi khi có Nâng Cấp kinh tế hoặc một Gặp Gỡ phù hợp.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 9 if you can roll 40g+ or if low hp.
tasks.en: Level to 9 if you can roll 40g+ or if low HP.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 9 nếu sau đó vẫn có thể roll với ít nhất 40 vàng, hoặc nếu máu của bạn đang thấp.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 9 and roll for important 5-costs. for the remainder of game, roll until you hit your 2 star itemized units. can consider level 10 after hitting.
tasks.en: Level to 9 and roll for important 5-costs. For the remainder of game, roll until you hit your 2 star itemized units. Can consider level 10 after hitting.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 9 và roll tìm các tướng 5 vàng quan trọng. Trong phần còn lại của trận đấu, tiếp tục roll cho đến khi các tướng được trang bị chủ lực lên 2 sao. Sau khi đạt được, có thể cân nhắc lên cấp 10.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::this is an uncommon econ strategy. sometimes there are zero comps in the meta that use it.
tasks.en: This is an uncommon econ strategy. Sometimes there are zero comps in the meta that use it.
tasks.vi: Đây là chiến thuật kinh tế ít phổ biến. Đôi khi meta không có đội hình nào sử dụng chiến thuật này.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::unlike 1-cost reroll, stay above 50g for entirety of stage 3. slow roll to ~52g for the remainder of the stage, buying all necessary 1-costs and 2-costs.
tasks.en: Unlike 1-cost reroll, stay above 50g for entirety of stage 3. Slow roll to ~52g for the remainder of the stage, buying all necessary 1-costs and 2-costs.
tasks.vi: Khác với chiến thuật roll tướng 1 vàng, hãy giữ trên 50 vàng trong toàn bộ Giai đoạn 3. Slow roll quanh mốc 52 vàng trong phần còn lại của giai đoạn, đồng thời mua tất cả tướng 1 vàng và 2 vàng cần thiết.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::if you haven't hit your 3-stars yet, you must roll until you hit them. level to 6 after hitting. you should be close to having a 2-cost 3-star unit as well. in some cases, you can level to 6 before hitting all 1-costs if you have many copies of your 1-costs, but not many of your 2-cost.
tasks.en: If you haven't hit your 3-stars yet, you must roll until you hit them. Level to 6 after hitting. You should be close to having a 2-cost 3-star unit as well. In some cases, you can level to 6 before hitting all 1-costs if you have many copies of your 1-costs, but not many of your 2-cost.
tasks.vi: Nếu chưa có các tướng 3 sao, hãy tiếp tục roll cho đến khi đạt được rồi lên cấp 6. Lúc này bạn cũng nên tiến gần đến việc có một tướng 2 vàng 3 sao. Trong một số trường hợp, bạn có thể lên cấp 6 trước khi hoàn tất toàn bộ tướng 1 vàng nếu đã có nhiều bản sao tướng 1 vàng nhưng còn ít bản sao tướng 2 vàng.
Nếu chưa lên cấp 6, hãy lên ngay.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you can stay above 20g, otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you can stay above 20g, otherwise stay level 6.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8. most likely end the game on 8, so roll for remaining important units. if far ahead, can save and try to go 9 in stage 6.
tasks.en: Level to 8. Most likely end the game on 8, so roll for remaining important units. If far ahead, can save and try to go 9 in stage 6.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8. Nhiều khả năng bạn sẽ kết thúc trận ở cấp này, vì vậy hãy roll tìm các tướng quan trọng còn thiếu. Nếu đang dẫn trước nhiều, bạn có thể tích vàng và thử lên cấp 9 ở Giai đoạn 6.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::this is an uncommon econ strategy. most of the time, there are zero comps in the meta that use it.
tasks.en: This is an uncommon econ strategy. Most of the time, there are zero comps in the meta that use it.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you can stay above ~30g. otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you can stay above ~30g. Otherwise stay level 6.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7 nếu vẫn giữ được khoảng 30 vàng trở lên; nếu không, ở lại cấp 6.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7. slow roll for the next full stage for 3-cost 3 star.
tasks.en: Level to 7. Slow roll for the next full stage for 3-cost 3 star.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 7. Trong toàn bộ giai đoạn tiếp theo, hãy slow roll để tìm tướng 3 vàng 3 sao.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8 if you've hit your 3-cost 3 star. stay level 7 and roll for it otherwise.
tasks.en: Level to 8 if you've hit your 3-cost 3 star. Stay level 7 and roll for it otherwise.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8 nếu đã có tướng 3 vàng 3 sao. Nếu chưa, hãy giữ cấp 7 và tiếp tục roll để tìm tướng đó.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 8 if you've hit your 3-cost 3 star. at this point, you're likely dead if you haven't hit it yet.
tasks.en: Level to 8 if you've hit your 3-cost 3 star. At this point, you're likely dead if you haven't hit it yet.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 8 nếu đã có tướng 3 vàng 3 sao. Nếu đến thời điểm này vẫn chưa tìm được, khả năng cao bạn sẽ bị loại sớm.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 6. roll until stable. "stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch, but generally speaking it involves 2-starring your desired 2-cost carry and a tank with items. major divergence between elos: the lower your elo, the less upgrades you need to be "stable" and thus lower elo players should generally roll less than high elo players on 3-2.
tasks.en: Level to 6. Roll until stable. "Stable" changes depending on rank, items, augments, composition, and patch, but generally speaking it involves 2-starring your desired 2-cost carry and a tank with items. Major divergence between elos: The lower your elo, the less upgrades you need to be "stable" and thus lower elo players should generally roll less than high elo players on 3-2.
tasks.vi: Lên cấp 6 rồi roll đến khi đội hình đủ ổn định. Mức độ ổn định phụ thuộc vào rank, trang bị, Nâng Cấp, đội hình và bản cập nhật; thông thường, bạn cần chủ lực 2 vàng dự định chơi lên 2 sao cùng một tướng chống chịu có trang bị. Ở rank thấp, bạn cần ít nâng cấp hơn để ổn định, vì vậy thường nên roll ít hơn người chơi rank cao ở vòng 3-2.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::unlike 2-cost reroll, you generally cannot afford to dip below 50g this stage. if you have to due to hp, you're likely going to end up in a bottom 4 placement. slow roll to ~53g this stage, picking up your 2-costs and 3-costs.
tasks.en: Unlike 2-cost reroll, you generally cannot afford to dip below 50g this stage. If you have to due to HP, you're likely going to end up in a bottom 4 placement. Slow roll to ~53g this stage, picking up your 2-costs and 3-costs.
tasks.vi: Khác với chiến thuật roll tướng 2 vàng, thông thường bạn không nên xuống dưới 50 vàng trong giai đoạn này. Nếu buộc phải làm vậy vì lượng máu thấp, nhiều khả năng bạn sẽ kết thúc ở nhóm 4 vị trí cuối. Hãy slow roll quanh mốc 53 vàng trong giai đoạn này, đồng thời mua các tướng 2 vàng và 3 vàng cần thiết.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::in some metas, this econ strategy levels to 7 here and slow rolls at 50g until stage 5. if you have high hp, you can defer going level 7 until 4-5.
tasks.en: In some metas, this econ strategy levels to 7 here and slow rolls at 50g until stage 5. If you have high HP, you can defer going level 7 until 4-5.
tasks.vi: Ở một số meta, chiến thuật này sẽ lên cấp 7 tại đây rồi slow roll quanh mốc 50 vàng cho đến Giai đoạn 5. Nếu còn nhiều máu, bạn có thể hoãn lên cấp 7 đến vòng 4-5.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::level to 7 if you didn't on 4-2 and continue to slow roll above 50g.
tasks.en: Level to 7 if you didn't on 4-2 and continue to slow roll above 50g.
tasks.vi: Nếu chưa lên cấp 7 ở vòng 4-2, hãy lên cấp 7 và tiếp tục slow roll, giữ trên 50 vàng.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::roll to 0g, trying to hit your key 2 and 3-cost 3 stars. you'll want your carry and tank upgraded at a minimum.
tasks.en: Roll to 0g, trying to hit your key 2 and 3-cost 3 stars. You'll want your carry and tank upgraded at a minimum.
tasks.vi: Roll hết về 0 vàng để tìm các tướng 2 vàng và 3 vàng chủ chốt lên 3 sao. Ít nhất, bạn cần nâng cấp chủ lực và tướng chống chịu.

tasks.id: economy::round-plan::from this point onward, attempt to level to 8 and add any key remaining units to your board.
tasks.en: From this point onward, attempt to level to 8 and add any key remaining units to your board.
tasks.vi: Từ thời điểm này, hãy cố gắng lên cấp 8 và bổ sung những tướng chủ chốt còn thiếu vào đội hình.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::there are two main versions: the shen amumu version and the lillia rakan version. shen amumu looks better, although lillia rakan gets 1 more trait if you have bronze for life
tasks.en: There are two main versions: The Shen Amumu version and the Lillia Rakan version. Shen Amumu looks better, although Lillia Rakan gets 1 more trait if you have Bronze for Life

tasks.en: One strength of this line is you can easily hit the full board on level 8 since it doesn't require any 5-costs and can be quite strong with combat augments

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the main reasoning behind the unit to left of sett is to prevent kha'zix from walking up and immediately killing your corner carry. the main objective for positioning against kha'zix is to make sure he can't walk into your frontline at the start of the fight.
tasks.en: The main reasoning behind the unit to left of Sett is to prevent Kha'Zix from walking up and immediately killing your corner carry. The main objective for positioning against Kha'Zix is to make sure he can't walk into your frontline at the start of the fight.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this means you don't need the unit to the left of sett if there are no kha'zix players in your pool.
tasks.en: This means you don't need the unit to the left of Sett if there are no Kha'Zix players in your pool.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::while some have played this line with yorick or rakan instead of ornn, ornn seems much better and has a better level 4 and 5 board.
tasks.en: While some have played this line with Yorick or Rakan instead of Ornn, Ornn seems much better and has a better level 4 and 5 board.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this is more of a 1-cost reroll line than 1 and 2 cost reroll. the goal is to 3 star all 5 1-costs to unlock the solar trait breakpoint.
tasks.en: This is more of a 1-cost reroll line than 1 and 2 cost reroll. The goal is to 3 star all 5 1-costs to unlock the Solar trait breakpoint.

tasks.en: When rolling in Stage 3, try to only buy Starfall, Starting Town, an econ wisp, or item wisp (permanent items, not temporary). Field of Mice was disabled in 18.2.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::akali can be played as ad or ap. both are fine. ad is slightly easier to play around since you'll want to build sunder for camille anyway, but if you have ap items it's fine to play around ap akali. you can see both builds by clicking "ad" or "ap" under akali in the builds section.
tasks.en: Akali can be played as AD or AP. Both are fine. AD is slightly easier to play around since you'll want to build Sunder for Camille anyway, but if you have AP items it's fine to play around AP Akali. You can see both builds by clicking "AD" or "AP" under Akali in the Builds section.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::part of what makes this line situationally better than the kayle reroll line is the fact it can win early rounds much easier and is less expensive to stabilize on since it doesn't require any 2-cost 3 stars.
tasks.en: Part of what makes this line situationally better than the Kayle reroll line is the fact it can win early rounds much easier and is less expensive to stabilize on since it doesn't require any 2-cost 3 stars.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::late-game, there are a few ways to play the endgame board. the main flex slots are lillia, fiddlesticks, morgana, and ivern. a few examples are provided of how you can flex the endgame board. lunar, primal, or coven lux should always go on the final board (turtle blessing).
tasks.en: Late-game, there are a few ways to play the endgame board. The main flex slots are Lillia, Fiddlesticks, Morgana, and Ivern. A few examples are provided of how you can flex the endgame board. Lunar, Primal, or Coven Lux should always go on the final board (Turtle Blessing).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::to fit lux, you can either drop morgana or ivern. ivern is better long-term, but morgana 2 can be hard to drop at some points in the game so you'll have to make a judgment call on what's best for your spot.
tasks.en: To fit Lux, you can either drop Morgana or Ivern. Ivern is better long-term, but Morgana 2 can be hard to drop at some points in the game so you'll have to make a judgment call on what's best for your spot.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::alune is highly flexible with her items. just make sure she has at least 1 mana item (shojin, blue buff, adaptive, nashor with jg) and 1 ap item.
tasks.en: Alune is highly flexible with her items. Just make sure she has at least 1 mana item (Shojin, Blue Buff, Adaptive, Nashor with JG) and 1 AP item.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the champions on the edge positioning is useful against kha'zix (you want to prevent him from walking up to your frontline row), but otherwise is generally unnecessary.
tasks.en: The champions on the edge positioning is useful against Kha'Zix (you want to prevent him from walking up to your frontline row), but otherwise is generally unnecessary.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::ad items in the item priority matrix are if you are dropped many swords, in which case you should play the elder dragon variation.
tasks.en: AD items in the item priority matrix are if you are dropped many swords, in which case you should play the Elder Dragon variation.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::it's not mandatory to play rakan + lillia. can play hecarim instead of rakan and drop lillia for a 5 cost (no defender).
tasks.en: It's not mandatory to play Rakan + Lillia. Can play Hecarim instead of Rakan and drop Lillia for a 5 cost (no Defender).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp was previously listed as fast 8, but generally it is played as fast 9 since ashe is important for the board to work. pivot to a sivir + nidalee comp if forced to stay level 8 long-term.
tasks.en: This comp was previously listed as Fast 8, but generally it is played as Fast 9 since Ashe is important for the board to work. Pivot to a Sivir + Nidalee comp if forced to stay level 8 long-term.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for the level 8 board, play around 4 juggernaut + sivir + hunter + 2 flex slots. the choice of what slots to play depends on what units you already have and what your boards needs (extra tankiness or damage). transition to the final board as you hit the relevant 5-costs.
tasks.en: For the Level 8 board, play around 4 Juggernaut + Sivir + Hunter + 2 flex slots. The choice of what slots to play depends on what units you already have and what your boards needs (extra tankiness or damage). Transition to the final board as you hit the relevant 5-costs.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::if playing around the lillia version, amumu is a better tank than lillia.
tasks.en: If playing around the Lillia version, Amumu is a better tank than Lillia.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::default to blessing of the turtle. can take bear if fully itemized sivir 2 with no ashe items yet. can take tiger if forced to pivot to nidalee + sivir duo carry on level 8 (ideally with both having shojin). when in doubt, take turtle.
tasks.en: Default to Blessing of the Turtle. Can take Bear if fully itemized Sivir 2 with no Ashe items yet. Can take Tiger if forced to pivot to Nidalee + Sivir duo carry on Level 8 (ideally with both having Shojin). When in doubt, take Turtle.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::kha'zix only needs to get executioner in this line before you start sacrificing him to the blackthorn hex. that is part of what makes this line unique: because it plays around azir carry with a non-blackthorn tank, you can sacrifice an ap unit instead of tank unit.
tasks.en: Kha'Zix only needs to get Executioner in this line before you start sacrificing him to the Blackthorn hex. That is part of what makes this line unique: Because it plays around Azir carry with a non-Blackthorn tank, you can sacrifice an AP unit instead of tank unit.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this means you can play this line even if you do not have early kha'zix copies. most people do not reroll kha'zix unless they have him in stage 2, so make sure to scout early to ensure you are uncontested.
tasks.en: This means you can play this line even if you do not have early Kha'Zix copies. Most people do not reroll Kha'Zix unless they have him in Stage 2, so make sure to scout early to ensure you are uncontested.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::at 3 stars, sacrificing kha'zix provides azir over 40% damage amp and 6 mana per second so focus on giving azir gunblade, ap items, and attack speed. striker's is an acceptable damage amp item because it gives crit.
tasks.en: At 3 stars, sacrificing Kha'Zix provides Azir over 40% damage amp and 6 mana per second so focus on giving Azir Gunblade, AP items, and Attack Speed. Striker's is an acceptable damage amp item because it gives crit.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::sacrificing kha'zix also means you don't technically need rageblade. it's still a good item when paired with rabadon's or archangel, but because azir has an additional 6 mana per second he will still cast often and his cast gives him 150% attack speed.
tasks.en: Sacrificing Kha'Zix also means you don't technically need Rageblade. It's still a good item when paired with Rabadon's or Archangel, but because Azir has an additional 6 mana per second he will still cast often and his cast gives him 150% Attack Speed.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this means ideally every azir build has gunblade + rabadon's or archangel, but the 3rd item is relatively flexible.
tasks.en: This means ideally every Azir build has Gunblade + Rabadon's or Archangel, but the 3rd item is relatively flexible.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::void staff is ideal because it is a great azir item before you can get 3 full proper items on him. if you have to build ionic spark instead, try to get into a place where it goes onto sett instead of vi (always aim to have 3 "real" tank items on vi). it's better to play void on azir than spark on vi
tasks.en: Void Staff is ideal because it is a great Azir item before you can get 3 full proper items on him. If you have to build Ionic Spark instead, try to get into a place where it goes onto Sett instead of Vi (always aim to have 3 "real" tank items on Vi). It's better to play Void on Azir than Spark on Vi

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::since zyra is the best holder of utility and secondary carry items, it's possible that it's better to play zyra over sett on level 7. be flexible based on your items and frontline needs.
tasks.en: Since Zyra is the best holder of utility and secondary carry items, it's possible that it's better to play Zyra over Sett on level 7. Be flexible based on your items and frontline needs.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this line has had terrible performance on a whole, but looks decent if you are able to get kha'zix to 3 traits. the bigger issue with the line might just be azir not doing enough.
tasks.en: This line has had terrible performance on a whole, but looks decent if you are able to get Kha'Zix to 3 traits. The bigger issue with the line might just be Azir not doing enough.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the main board is 5 blossom + juggernaut + brawler + 2 flex slots. vi + sivir + zyra is common, but can also play maokai over vi and zyra can be replaced with ivern or lux. sivir is not as important if not playing around vi.
tasks.en: The main board is 5 Blossom + Juggernaut + Brawler + 2 Flex Slots. Vi + Sivir + Zyra is common, but can also play Maokai over Vi and Zyra can be replaced with Ivern or Lux. Sivir is not as important if not playing around Vi.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp is flexible on emblems thanks to the flexible unit slots.
tasks.en: This comp is flexible on Emblems thanks to the flexible unit slots.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::blossom emblem is strong because it allows you to play 7 blossom on 8 consistently even without ahri. the extra gold from 7 blossom helps you hit the full board and go 9.
tasks.en: Blossom Emblem is strong because it allows you to play 7 Blossom on 8 consistently even without Ahri. The extra gold from 7 Blossom helps you hit the full board and go 9.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::5 blossom boards tend to cap higher than 7 blossom boards since the primary benefit of 7 blossom is the extra gold. play 7 blossom as long as possible, then look to move out of 7 blossom late game once you need to stabilize.
tasks.en: 5 Blossom boards tend to cap higher than 7 Blossom boards since the primary benefit of 7 Blossom is the extra gold. Play 7 Blossom as long as possible, then look to move out of 7 Blossom late game once you need to stabilize.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::position ahri on the same side as the opponent's carry. much of the strength of this comp comes from the fact that ahri can kill the opponent's backline before their tank.
tasks.en: Position Ahri on the same side as the opponent's carry. Much of the strength of this comp comes from the fact that Ahri can kill the opponent's backline before their tank.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::ahri's ability to kill the backline is part of why having perfect items on her and 2 starring her as soon as possible are important. it helps give her enough damage to ensure she can kill the backline rather than leave them barely alive.
tasks.en: Ahri's ability to kill the backline is part of why having perfect items on her and 2 starring her as soon as possible are important. It helps give her enough damage to ensure she can kill the backline rather than leave them barely alive.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::part of why executioner emblem is so good for this line is because it helps ahri meet the threshold killing backline by giving her an execute and it enables playing kennen which also helps kill the backline.
tasks.en: Part of why Executioner Emblem is so good for this line is because it helps Ahri meet the threshold killing backline by giving her an execute AND it enables playing Kennen which also helps kill the backline.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::item augments are strong in this line since the comp can itemize 3 carries easily on level 8 (ezreal + soraka + ahri)
tasks.en: Item augments are strong in this line since the comp can itemize 3 carries easily on Level 8 (Ezreal + Soraka + Ahri)

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::executioner emblem is especially strong on ahri in this line as it allows you to play 4 executioner with all of your itemized carries being executioners.
tasks.en: Executioner Emblem is especially strong on Ahri in this line as it allows you to play 4 Executioner with all of your itemized carries being Executioners.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::can build ad or ap items first, but try to always itemize ezreal + one of the ap carries ideally. for your secondary carry, prioritize ahri over soraka usually so that ezreal + ahri can kill backline together.
tasks.en: Can build AD or AP items first, but try to always itemize Ezreal + one of the AP carries ideally. For your secondary carry, prioritize Ahri over Soraka usually so that Ezreal + Ahri can kill backline together.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the main concept behind this fast 9 line is to play around ahri + sett + ashe. this leads to almost always playing around alune and gnar. from there you need to fill out the frontline.
tasks.en: The main concept behind this Fast 9 line is to play around Ahri + Sett + Ashe. This leads to almost always playing around Alune and Gnar. From there you need to fill out the frontline.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::there are four jug options: vi + sivir, amumu + kennen, rakan, and maokai. rakan makes it possible to crossover with a vanguard such as taric, sentinel, or diana. maokai is good if found early enough as he's the best tank in the game if he farms enough hp from his trait.
tasks.en: There are four Jug options: Vi + Sivir, Amumu + Kennen, Rakan, and Maokai. Rakan makes it possible to crossover with a Vanguard such as Taric, Sentinel, or Diana. Maokai is good if found early enough as he's the best tank in the game if he farms enough HP from his trait.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::in general the goal for the frontline is to play around upgraded units, not the perfect optimal board. flex the appropriate packages based on what frontline units you hit.
tasks.en: In general the goal for the frontline is to play around upgraded units, not the perfect optimal board. Flex the appropriate packages based on what frontline units you hit.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::itemize scuttlecrab first and then any additional tank items can go onto sejuani
tasks.en: Itemize Scuttlecrab first and then any additional tank items can go onto Sejuani

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::last whisper and red buff are better than evenshroud and sunfire usually, but in this comp it's difficult to make those items since caitlyn wants 3 bow items. build whatever utility option is available for you with your items.
tasks.en: Last Whisper and Red Buff are better than Evenshroud and Sunfire usually, but in this comp it's difficult to make those items since Caitlyn wants 3 Bow items. Build whatever utility option is available for you with your items.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::6 juggernaut might be better than 4 juggernaut on level 8, especially if you don't have ashe
tasks.en: 6 Juggernaut might be better than 4 Juggernaut on Level 8, especially if you don't have Ashe

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the best primal is turtle usually. only exception is if you have strong frontline and 3 items for sivir, then you can take bear (very rare because it requires many items and high econ board).
tasks.en: The best primal is Turtle usually. Only exception is if you have strong frontline and 3 items for Sivir, then you can take Bear (very rare because it requires many items and high econ board).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the nerfs to dark ritual in patch 18.4 have made this comp weaker than it was before. the comp is more conditional now - aim to play if you have good components / can play good losses or need direction.
tasks.en: The nerfs to Dark Ritual in Patch 18.4 have made this comp weaker than it was before. The comp is more conditional now - aim to play if you have good components / can play good losses or need direction.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::prioritize taking cassiopeia on first carousel regardless of the component most of the time - it's more important to make sure you get 4 coven as early as possible than perfect items.
tasks.en: Prioritize taking Cassiopeia on first carousel regardless of the component most of the time - It's more important to make sure you get 4 Coven as early as possible than perfect items.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::two ways to play this comp: reroll or fast 8. reroll version of comp should roll on level 6 and 7 and go for elise 3 + ideally cassio 3. for fast 8, hold extra copies of cassio on level 8 and try to 3 star her while playing 6 vanguard or 4 vanguard + legendaries.
tasks.en: Two ways to play this comp: Reroll or Fast 8. Reroll version of comp should roll on level 6 and 7 and go for Elise 3 + ideally Cassio 3. For Fast 8, hold extra copies of Cassio on Level 8 and try to 3 star her while playing 6 Vanguard or 4 Vanguard + Legendaries.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::when playing reroll, itemize elise 3 as she can go infinite with the ap from augment. when pushing levels, play around elise 2 as your tank until you 2-star sentinel or taric, then switch tanks. previously fast 8 was more common, but now reroll is looking more common.
tasks.en: When playing reroll, itemize Elise 3 as she can go infinite with the AP from augment. When pushing levels, play around Elise 2 as your tank until you 2-star Sentinel or Taric, then switch tanks. Previously Fast 8 was more common, but now reroll is looking more common.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::aim for 250 cashout if possible. prior to patch 18.4, there was a strategy to cashout 130 twice so you could win rounds in stage 3, but post-nerf this strategy is weaker than it was before.
tasks.en: Aim for 250 cashout if possible. Prior to patch 18.4, there was a strategy to cashout 130 twice so you could win rounds in Stage 3, but post-nerf this strategy is weaker than it was before.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the reason for titan's resolve on elise in the reroll version is because with the ap from dark ritual, she often is unkillable as she heals back up with each auto attack. often the only way for her to die is crowd control ("cc") or her walking up toward the end of a fight.
tasks.en: The reason for Titan's Resolve on Elise in the reroll version is because with the AP from Dark Ritual, she often is unkillable as she heals back up with each auto attack. Often the only way for her to die is crowd control ("CC") or her walking up toward the end of a fight.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::rageblade is a good item on elise 3, but not necessary. two tank items + titan's or even 3 tank items are fine builds too, but it becomes more important to have good cassio / morgana items in these cases.
tasks.en: Rageblade is a good item on Elise 3, but not necessary. Two tank items + Titan's or even 3 tank items are fine builds too, but it becomes more important to have good Cassio / Morgana items in these cases.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for positioning elise 3, try to avoid solo frontline in stage 5 onward. in an ideal world, she doesn't take all aggro because it is possible for opponents to burst her down late game. the goal is split aggro enough that she drain tanks and sustains, but not so much that she dies.
tasks.en: For positioning Elise 3, try to avoid solo frontline in Stage 5 onward. In an ideal world, she doesn't take all aggro because it is possible for opponents to burst her down late game. The goal is split aggro enough that she drain tanks and sustains, but not so much that she dies.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not pass by coven lux if you hit her. she is a massive spike - her passive and ability help all your coven units, plus she does a ton of damage with the ap from augment.
tasks.en: Do not pass by Coven Lux if you hit her. She is a massive spike - her passive and ability help all your Coven units, plus she does a ton of damage with the AP from augment.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::archangel is better than rabadon's. as part of the unreal engine transition, damage over time (dot) champions now have their dots update their damage as the caster's ap increases rather than snapshotting on cast.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the idea behind the fiddle build is to have him cast as much as possible to help cassiopeia take enemies down and heal himself. adaptive helm increases his mana gain from flora fatalis and he gets plenty of tankiness from 6 defender and gunblade. titan's gives him cc immunity.
tasks.en: The idea behind the Fiddle build is to have him cast as much as possible to help Cassiopeia take enemies down and heal himself. Adaptive Helm increases his mana gain from Flora Fatalis and he gets plenty of tankiness from 6 Defender and Gunblade. Titan's gives him CC immunity.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::you do not have to play the adaptive fiddle build. a typical build on him works too.
tasks.en: You do not have to play the Adaptive Fiddle build. A typical build on him works too.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::since this is primarily a 2 unit comp with cassiopeia and fiddle, combat augments that empower them are high priority.
tasks.en: Since this is primarily a 2 unit comp with Cassiopeia and Fiddle, combat augments that empower them are high priority.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::blue buff and shojin are both good on cassiopeia, but usually blue buff is hard to build if going for the adaptive build.
tasks.en: Blue Buff and Shojin are both good on Cassiopeia, but usually Blue Buff is hard to build if going for the Adaptive build.

tasks.en: While technically this comp can be played from Coven, it struggles to use items from Coven compared to standard fast 8 comps. Keep that in mind if playing around Coven opener.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::item augments are acceptable if they are guaranteed to provide tank items or perfect cassio items.

tasks.en: This comp has multiple scaling champions with Maokai, Draven, and sometimes Ivern. This makes hitting the board early exceptionally important compared to historical Fast 9 boards. Keep that in mind when angling the line.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::all of the emblems this comp can use do not require heavy substitutions. elderwood and brawler emblem replace alistar with sett or hecarim respectively. outside of that, all other emblems are as simple as just putting it on a unit to get full value out of them.
tasks.en: All of the Emblems this comp can use do not require heavy substitutions. Elderwood and Brawler Emblem replace Alistar with Sett or Hecarim respectively. Outside of that, all other Emblems are as simple as just putting it on a unit to get full value out of them.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this does not mean you should go out of your way to get emblems since gold is more important for reaching the final board. the only one actively worth making currently is executioner since it buffs both carries and is useable on draven.
tasks.en: This does not mean you should go out of your way to get Emblems since gold is more important for reaching the final board. The only one actively worth making currently is Executioner since it buffs both carries and is useable on Draven.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not make ivern 2 before you have your key 5-cost upgrades. he costs too much gold relative to the value he provides prior to hitting the other 5-costs.
tasks.en: Do not make Ivern 2 before you have your key 5-cost upgrades. He costs too much gold relative to the value he provides prior to hitting the other 5-costs.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::new line in patch 18.4. primarily played as reroll, although theoretically pushing levels might be possible in some games.
tasks.en: New line in Patch 18.4. Primarily played as reroll, although theoretically pushing levels might be possible in some games.

tasks.en: Lunar Emblem is key for making this line consistent with reroll. Without it, you can't activate 3 Lunar without hitting Alune or Lunar Lux.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::stats imply that playing around 5 3-stars is not necessary like most solar comps do. while you can roll for 3-star varus (and lunar emblem him since he uses mana regen unlike kayle), alune looks better on the end game board if you can find her (which you might if playing 3 inferno before)
tasks.en: Stats imply that playing around 5 3-stars is not necessary like most Solar comps do. While you can roll for 3-star Varus (and Lunar Emblem him since he uses Mana Regen unlike Kayle), Alune looks better on the end game board if you can find her (which you might if playing 3 Inferno before)

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for fast 8 eclipse, just push levels for higher lux or alune odds (play 3 inferno until you hit). in this case, you'd play around aphelios solo carry with as many tanks as possible. generally not very popular.
tasks.en: For fast 8 Eclipse, just push levels for higher Lux or Alune odds (play 3 Inferno until you hit). In this case, you'd play around Aphelios solo carry with as many tanks as possible. Generally not very popular.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp can play around almost every class emblem in the game and several origin emblems. out of the 20 unique emblems in the set, this comp can use 10 of them easily and several more with some adjustment so augments that give random emblems are good.
tasks.en: This comp can play around almost every class Emblem in the game and several origin emblems. Out of the 20 Unique emblems in the set, this comp can use 10 of them easily and several more with some adjustment so augments that give random Emblems are good.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the basic rule of thumb for this comp is that ivern and leblanc spots are flexible. leblanc always has to be replaced by an elderwood unit or emblem. ivern can be replaced by anything that helps an emblem or other upgraded unit fit.
tasks.en: The basic rule of thumb for this comp is that Ivern and LeBlanc spots are flexible. LeBlanc always has to be replaced by an Elderwood unit or Emblem. Ivern can be replaced by anything that helps an Emblem or other upgraded unit fit.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::note that replacing ivern requires the replacement to be "worth it". often getting another trait is not worth losing ivern's unique buffs. ivern 2 is almost never worth replacing.
tasks.en: Note that replacing Ivern requires the replacement to be "worth it". Often getting another trait is not worth losing Ivern's unique buffs. Ivern 2 is almost never worth replacing.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::can easily play around taric by playing hecarim instead of leblanc. this might even be stronger, but it's much lower sample.
tasks.en: Can easily play around Taric by playing Hecarim instead of LeBlanc. This might even be stronger, but it's much lower sample.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::elderwood emblem can go onto soraka before you have 3 items for her, ezreal, and hecarim. later it wants to go onto kennen or taric ideally as it provides some tankiness.
tasks.en: Elderwood Emblem can go onto Soraka before you have 3 items for her, Ezreal, and Hecarim. Later it wants to go onto Kennen or Taric ideally as it provides some tankiness.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::elderwood lux always makes it onto the board. can either play 9 elderwood (drop taric) or play 7 elderwood (drop leblanc + ornn or alistar for taric + kennen).
tasks.en: Elderwood Lux always makes it onto the board. Can either play 9 Elderwood (drop Taric) or play 7 Elderwood (drop LeBlanc + Ornn or Alistar for Taric + Kennen).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::xayah does not need rageblade, so prioritize rageblade on kayle over xayah.
tasks.en: Xayah does not need Rageblade, so prioritize Rageblade on Kayle over Xayah.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the comp is inflexible up to level 7 so emblems do not change the way you play the comp. the level 8 slot is flexible though so any emblem you can flex the level 8 slot around it. example: fae emblem = lillia on 8.
tasks.en: The comp is inflexible up to Level 7 so Emblems do not change the way you play the comp. The Level 8 slot is flexible though so any Emblem you can flex the Level 8 slot around it. Example: Fae Emblem = Lillia on 8.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the cursed crown board is a level 6 board, not level 8. roll on level 5 and 6 and try to hit 8 different 3-stars to activate the final trait breakpoint for solar which upgrades your units to 4 star throughout combat.
tasks.en: The Cursed Crown board is a level 6 board, not Level 8. Roll on Level 5 and 6 and try to hit 8 different 3-stars to activate the final trait breakpoint for Solar which upgrades your units to 4 star throughout combat.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this is just as much an ornn comp as it is a veigar comp. while blue buff + jg are important on veigar, make sure you are also prioritizing getting 3 items on ornn as soon as possible so he can stack to artifact faster.
tasks.en: This is just as much an Ornn comp as it is a Veigar comp. While Blue Buff + JG are important on Veigar, make sure you are also prioritizing getting 3 items on Ornn as soon as possible so he can stack to Artifact faster.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::since getting items on veigar and ornn early is important, often item augments on 2-1 are best for this line. item encounters are also good for a similar reason.
tasks.en: Since getting items on Veigar and Ornn early is important, often item augments on 2-1 are best for this line. Item encounters are also good for a similar reason.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::since we're playing around ornn as primary tank instead of rek'sai, your level 5 board can drop either rek'sai or alistar (hold on bench until you can level). losing blackthorn on level 5 is fine as you don't want to sac leblanc early game and elderwood doesn't fit with fiddle + blackthorn.
tasks.en: Since we're playing around Ornn as primary tank instead of Rek'Sai, your level 5 board can drop either Rek'Sai or Alistar (hold on bench until you can level). Losing Blackthorn on Level 5 is fine as you don't want to sac LeBlanc early game and Elderwood doesn't fit with Fiddle + Blackthorn.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::while low level, sac the lifebloom. late game you can sac any spellweaver to blackthorn. if you don't have strong items for leblanc, you can just sac 3-star leblanc. otherwise sac whoever gives the highest mana regen and damage amp to veigar.
tasks.en: While low level, sac the Lifebloom. Late game you can sac any Spellweaver to Blackthorn. If you don't have strong items for LeBlanc, you can just sac 3-star LeBlanc. Otherwise sac whoever gives the highest Mana Regen and Damage amp to Veigar.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::swap tank items to alistar after printing your first artifact.
tasks.en: Swap tank items to Alistar after printing your first Artifact.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::if you are 50g and have 7+ copies of ornn, roll to around 30g (can go even deeper with 8th copy) as 3-starring ornn earlier prints the artifact much faster. don't dig below 30g if you have only 1 item on him as 1 item ornn 3 still doesn't gather forge power that quickly.
tasks.en: If you are 50g and have 7+ copies of Ornn, roll to around 30g (can go even deeper with 8th copy) as 3-starring Ornn earlier prints the Artifact much faster. Don't dig below 30g if you have only 1 item on him as 1 item Ornn 3 still doesn't gather Forge Power that quickly.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp can use a lot of items and econ so generally speaking you will want to take augments that provide one of those two resources.
tasks.en: This comp can use a lot of items and econ so generally speaking you will want to take augments that provide one of those two resources.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the only utility this comp needs to build is sunder if itemizing varus or aphelios. kayle 20% shreds so you can also build shred, but it's less important than proper tank items and proper kayle items. the inferno units handle wound.
tasks.en: The only utility this comp needs to build is Sunder if itemizing Varus or Aphelios. Kayle 20% shreds so you can also build Shred, but it's less important than proper tank items and proper Kayle items. The Inferno units handle Wound.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::kayle wants rageblade + some collection of the following items: jeweled gauntlet (jg), rabadon's, giant slayer, striker's (only with jg), gunblade, second rageblade, or archangel's.
tasks.en: Kayle wants Rageblade + some collection of the following items: Jeweled Gauntlet (JG), Rabadon's, Giant Slayer, Striker's (only with JG), Gunblade, Second Rageblade, or Archangel's.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::void staff is ideal because often you do not want to play kog'maw on either level 8 or level 9 as he is hard to fit on level 8 and several 5-costs are better on 9.
tasks.en: Void Staff is ideal because often you do not want to play Kog'Maw on either Level 8 or Level 9 as he is hard to fit on level 8 and several 5-costs are better on 9.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::always itemize whoever is upgraded. if both sett and sentinel are upgraded, sett is generally a stronger tank. however, sentinel is strong against people who clump and let their carries get cc'd.
tasks.en: Always itemize whoever is upgraded. If both Sett and Sentinel are upgraded, Sett is generally a stronger tank. However, Sentinel is strong against people who clump and let their carries get CC'd.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this board is much easier to hit than the blossom board which requires ashe to perform well. this line can also use more ap items than the traditional blossom line
tasks.en: This board is much easier to hit than the Blossom board which requires Ashe to perform well. This line can also use more AP items than the traditional Blossom line

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::in the mirror match, make sure to position differently. this positioning is good for clumping enemies to the center of the board so morgana and ahri can kill them quickly, but is weak against other large aoe boards (such as the mirror match)
tasks.en: In the mirror match, make sure to position differently. This positioning is good for clumping enemies to the center of the board so Morgana and Ahri can kill them quickly, but is weak against other large AoE boards (such as the mirror match)

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::in late game, look to drop kog'maw and karma. standard swap is alune + ashe, but can also play around ivern and blossom / lunar lux in these flex slots.
tasks.en: In late game, look to drop Kog'Maw and Karma. Standard swap is Alune + Ashe, but can also play around Ivern and Blossom / Lunar Lux in these flex slots.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::before hitting taric, play around whatever upgraded vanguard unit you can hit to pair with sentinel or a random 5-cost if you have items on sett 2 and don't need vanguard as much.
tasks.en: Before hitting Taric, play around whatever upgraded Vanguard unit you can hit to pair with Sentinel or a random 5-cost if you have items on Sett 2 and don't need Vanguard as much.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::void staff is good on morgana even with kog'maw, but it is lower priority than other tear items.
tasks.en: Void Staff is good on Morgana even with Kog'Maw, but it is lower priority than other tear items.

tasks.en: You can check Coven cashouts by hovering the "Coven" trait in the "Traits" container and then clicking "View Tables". They also exist on this website under Info > Set 18 Tables > Coven.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::take blessing of the bear for primal blessing
tasks.en: Take Blessing of the Bear for Primal Blessing

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::void staff is still good on morgana even with kog'maw, but you do not need to prioritize it since rageblade is a more important item and tear can make several other good items.
tasks.en: Void Staff is still good on Morgana even with Kog'Maw, but you do not need to prioritize it since Rageblade is a more important item and Tear can make several other good items.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::move items from amumu to maokai once you have him 2 starred.
tasks.en: Move items from Amumu to Maokai once you have him 2 starred.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::archangel scaling is important to have enough damage since this is more of a stall comp. gunblade is good on zyra in this line for similar reasons.
tasks.en: Archangel scaling is important to have enough damage since this is more of a stall comp. Gunblade is good on Zyra in this line for similar reasons.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp used to play around morgana, but now often plays around sivir, nidalee, or ivern on 8 and then adds either ashe or ivern (if didn't play on 8) on 9.
tasks.en: This comp used to play around Morgana, but now often plays around Sivir, Nidalee, or Ivern on 8 and then adds either Ashe or Ivern (if didn't play on 8) on 9.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::rakan is played over sejuani because he provides attack speed to carry, which is even better when you build shojin on zyra.
tasks.en: Rakan is played over Sejuani because he provides Attack Speed to carry, which is even better when you build Shojin on Zyra.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::it's okay to take item augments if you need to build out your carry items still or are missing important utility. in an ideal world, the encounter helps provide items and you prioritize taking combat augments.
tasks.en: It's okay to take item augments if you need to build out your carry items still or are missing important utility. In an ideal world, the Encounter helps provide items and you prioritize taking combat augments.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::with seraphim's staff, best build is two archangels and gunblade (replace the shojin with an archangel).
tasks.en: With Seraphim's Staff, best build is two Archangels and Gunblade (replace the Shojin with an Archangel).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::diana is a real unit if you can 3-star her with leftover items. if you can afford to go for her (have gold / hp), then try to hit her
tasks.en: Diana is a real unit if you can 3-star her with leftover items. If you can afford to go for her (have gold / HP), then try to hit her

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::upgrade order for kha'zix is ravager > executioner > spellweaver / rapidfire. executioner is stronger than ravager if you have hand of justice and an executioner on your board, but usually this is not the case.
tasks.en: Upgrade order for Kha'Zix is Ravager > Executioner > Spellweaver / Rapidfire. Executioner is stronger than Ravager if you have Hand of Justice and an Executioner on your board, but usually this is not the case.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::there are a few different positionings, but standard is left or right side positioning (mirror the "main variation" for right side positioning). there's also a solo frontline positioning which is a bit more common itemized diana. aim to position kha'zix on same side as opponent carry.
tasks.en: There are a few different positionings, but standard is left or right side positioning (mirror the "Main variation" for right side positioning). There's also a solo frontline positioning which is a bit more common itemized Diana. Aim to position Kha'Zix on same side as opponent carry.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::with rengar, master yi will typically become ad regardless of how you build him. without rengar, he will typically be ap due to rageblade. prioritize best-in-slot master yi items - no need to force what type he is.
tasks.en: With Rengar, Master Yi will typically become AD regardless of how you build him. Without Rengar, he will typically be AP due to Rageblade. Prioritize best-in-slot Master Yi items - no need to force what type he is.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::vi is the better solo frontline tank, but you can play around krug if you hit it first. always try to play around vi though. krug can hold utility like evenshroud late-game.
tasks.en: Vi is the better solo frontline tank, but you can play around Krug if you hit it first. Always try to play around Vi though. Krug can hold utility like Evenshroud late-game.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::take turtle for the primal blessing
tasks.en: Take Turtle for the Primal Blessing

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not hold zyra while rolling on level 7. she's not even mandatory for the level 8 board - you can play kog'maw instead (especially if missing sunder). it is a waste of gold to hold onto the level 8 unit until you hit your 3-stars on level 7.
tasks.en: Do NOT hold Zyra while rolling on Level 7. She's not even mandatory for the Level 8 board - you can play Kog'Maw instead (especially if missing Sunder). It is a waste of gold to hold onto the Level 8 unit until you hit your 3-stars on Level 7.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::nidalee can carry ap or ad items as a tertiary carry, but make sure you prioritize 3 items on vi, master yi, and rengar first.
tasks.en: Nidalee can carry AP or AD items as a tertiary carry, but make sure you prioritize 3 items on Vi, Master Yi, and Rengar first.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::one of the greatest strengths of this comp is that it doesn't need to build utility. kog'maw provides sunder / shred and inferno provides wound (anti-heal). this means you can slam more aggressively early game for tempo.
tasks.en: One of the greatest strengths of this comp is that it doesn't need to build utility. Kog'Maw provides Sunder / Shred and Inferno provides Wound (Anti-heal). This means you can slam more aggressively early game for tempo.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for primal blessing, take either phoenix if you get primal early stage 3 and can get takedowns. take turtle or tiger otherwise.
tasks.en: For Primal Blessing, take either Phoenix if you get Primal early Stage 3 and can get takedowns. Take Turtle or Tiger otherwise.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this is a comp that was played during pbe, but no longer played as riftbeasts vertical is generally just better. can consider playing from worth the wait pebbles, otherwise play other lines. this is primary reason for d-tier ranking.
tasks.en: This is a comp that was played during PBE, but no longer played as Riftbeasts vertical is generally just better. Can consider playing from Worth the Wait Pebbles, otherwise play other lines. This is primary reason for D-tier ranking.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::while you can play around 5 riftbeast for the shops before hitting pebbles 3, the best endgame board appears to be 5 invoker which helps pebbles go infinite.
tasks.en: While you can play around 5 Riftbeast for the shops before hitting Pebbles 3, the best endgame board appears to be 5 Invoker which helps Pebbles go infinite.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp can use many tears, so always almost always prioritize them on carousel.
tasks.en: This comp can use many tears, so always almost always prioritize them on Carousel.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::pebbles needs ~17.1 mana regen (round up to 18) + alpha mark to go infinite. going infinite does not look mandatory, but it is worth noting. double mana allows for sentinel alpha mark and can still go infinite (need 2 sentinel casts with 21 regen+).
tasks.en: Pebbles needs ~17.1 Mana Regen (round up to 18) + Alpha Mark to go infinite. Going infinite does not look mandatory, but it is worth noting. Double mana allows for Sentinel Alpha Mark and can still go infinite (need 2 Sentinel casts with 21 regen+).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::if you build double mana on pebbles (blue + blue or blue + adaptive), the last item really wants to be rabadon's or pebbles will not do enough damage.
tasks.en: If you build double mana on Pebbles (Blue + Blue or Blue + Adaptive), the last item really wants to be Rabadon's or Pebbles will not do enough damage.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::alpha mark is not solved for this line. current theory i have is this: below 17 mana regen use it on sentinel or scuttle. between 17 and 20 use on pebbles for infinite cast. from 21 to 23, use on sentinel for infinite cast + teamwide regen. it's possible scuttle is always better.
tasks.en: Alpha Mark is not solved for this line. Current theory I have is this: Below 17 mana regen use it on Sentinel or Scuttle. Between 17 and 20 use on Pebbles for infinite cast. From 21 to 23, use on Sentinel for infinite cast + teamwide regen. It's possible Scuttle is always better.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::all the mana values mentioned here are for 70 max mana and 35% mana drain per second, so verify against pebble's tooltip in case these tips go out of date.
tasks.en: All the mana values mentioned here are for 70 Max Mana and 35% Mana Drain per second, so verify against Pebble's tooltip in case these tips go out of date.
