tasks.en: Sacrifice either Teemo or Soraka to Blackthorn hex. 3-star Teemo is slightly more stats than 2-star Soraka, but is more expensive so often it is better to just go for 2-star Soraka on Level 7 rather than 3-star Teemo. Sacrifice 2-star Teemo over 1-star Soraka.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::can drop teemo for gnar since you can always sacrifice soraka to the blackthorn hex. do not sacrifice gnar.
tasks.en: Can drop Teemo for Gnar since you can always sacrifice Soraka to the Blackthorn hex. Do not sacrifice Gnar.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::late-game (stage 5+) you will ideally want fiddlesticks 3 in addition to rammus to hold down the frontline. there isn't much to level for on 8, so staying level 7 for hitting fiddle is reasonable if you are close.
tasks.en: Late-game (Stage 5+) you will ideally want Fiddlesticks 3 in addition to Rammus to hold down the frontline. There isn't much to level for on 8, so staying Level 7 for hitting Fiddle is reasonable if you are close.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::level 8 add an executioner, sentinel, lillia, yorick, or a random 5-cost like ivern.
tasks.en: Level 8 add an Executioner, Sentinel, Lillia, Yorick, or a random 5-cost like Ivern.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::rageblade on azir is a good item, but not necessary. sacrificing an ap unit like teemo to blackthorn gives mana regen, meaning he will cast even without rageblade, but often the item is still solid for a tempo slam. prioritize other rod items over it though.
tasks.en: Rageblade on Azir is a good item, but not necessary. Sacrificing an AP unit like Teemo to Blackthorn gives Mana Regen, meaning he will cast even without Rageblade, but often the item is still solid for a tempo slam. Prioritize other Rod items over it though.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::one strong reason to play this over the vi blossom version is it fits better on level 7. the other version struggles to play zyra on level 7, so if you have a surplus of items, generally consider this line over vi + azir
tasks.en: One strong reason to play this over the Vi Blossom version is it fits better on Level 7. The other version struggles to play Zyra on Level 7, so if you have a surplus of items, generally consider this line over Vi + Azir

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::rapidfire emblem is mandatory for this line. the spike from 4 to 5 rapidfire is huge and it is a strong item on brambleback.
tasks.en: Rapidfire Emblem is mandatory for this line. The spike from 4 to 5 Rapidfire is huge and it is a strong item on Brambleback.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not build rageblade on aphelios. 5 rapidfire provides more than enough attack speed. aim for items that give ad, crit, or damage amp such as kraken, infinity edge, deathblade, giant slayer, or striker's. utility like red buff / last whisper or gunblade are fine too.
tasks.en: Do not build Rageblade on Aphelios. 5 Rapidfire provides more than enough attack speed. Aim for items that give AD, crit, or damage amp such as Kraken, Infinity Edge, Deathblade, Giant Slayer, or Striker's. Utility like Red Buff / Last Whisper or Gunblade are fine too.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::note that this line plays inferno, so red buff is not important on aphelios like it is in the other aphelios comps. sunder is still important.
tasks.en: Note that this line plays Inferno, so Red Buff is not important on Aphelios like it is in the other Aphelios comps. Sunder is still important.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::diana or taric is played on level 9. can also drop rakan for maokai on 9 once you play either diana or taric. taric is better than diana if same star level. diana 2 is probably slightly better than taric 1. do not drop 5 rapidfire for 4 vanguard.
tasks.en: Diana or Taric is played on Level 9. Can also drop Rakan for Maokai on 9 once you play either Diana or Taric. Taric is better than Diana if same star level. Diana 2 is probably slightly better than Taric 1. Do not drop 5 Rapidfire for 4 Vanguard.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::prioritize itemizing whoever is upgraded first between amumu and sentinel. if both are upgraded or 1 star, prioritize itemizing amumu.
tasks.en: Prioritize itemizing whoever is upgraded first between Amumu and Sentinel. If both are upgraded or 1 star, prioritize itemizing Amumu.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for sunder, last whisper on mama beak is strong as an alternative to evenshroud on hecarim. evenshroud looks slightly better though and bows are in high demand in this comp so most of the time you should build evenshroud over last whisper.
tasks.en: For Sunder, Last Whisper on Mama Beak is strong as an alternative to Evenshroud on Hecarim. Evenshroud looks slightly better though and Bows are in high demand in this comp so most of the time you should build Evenshroud over Last Whisper.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::play standard instead of reroll. do not need 5 riftbeast as early as reroll version because this line doesn't play around pebbles or cinderling 3. still want it by 3-1 though to get 3-5 riftbeast shop for ideally 7 riftbeast on 3-5.
tasks.en: Play standard instead of reroll. Do not need 5 Riftbeast as early as reroll version because this line doesn't play around Pebbles or Cinderling 3. Still want it by 3-1 though to get 3-5 Riftbeast shop for ideally 7 Riftbeast on 3-5.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::brambleback wants rageblade + edge of night + flexible 3rd item such as hoj, qss, bloodthirster, etc.
tasks.en: Brambleback wants Rageblade + Edge of Night + Flexible 3rd item such as HoJ, QSS, Bloodthirster, etc.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::combat augments are good because this version of riftbeasts aims to make brambleback go infinite at the end of the fight and the comp can usually hit its 4-costs thanks to 5 riftbeast.
tasks.en: Combat augments are good because this version of Riftbeasts aims to make Brambleback go infinite at the end of the fight and the comp can usually hit its 4-costs thanks to 5 Riftbeast.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::can play around sentinel 2 over krug 2 before hitting krug 3.
tasks.en: Can play around Sentinel 2 over Krug 2 before hitting Krug 3.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::it is acceptable to slight roll on level 7 for 7 riftbeast if you are likely to hit it as it is a major spike. ideally stay above 30g. whether this is correct will vary by game and when your riftbeast shop is.
tasks.en: It is acceptable to slight roll on Level 7 for 7 Riftbeast if you are likely to hit it as it is a major spike. Ideally stay above 30g. Whether this is correct will vary by game and when your Riftbeast shop is.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::must have 5 riftbeast by 3-1. roll for it if need be (sometimes correct to roll for it in stage 2). ideally want to minimize rolls before level 7. this is why having at least 3 copies of cinderling or pebbles early is important so you can reasonably hit 3-star without rolling much before 7.
tasks.en: Must have 5 Riftbeast by 3-1. Roll for it if need be (sometimes correct to roll for it in Stage 2). Ideally want to minimize rolls before level 7. This is why having at least 3 copies of Cinderling or Pebbles early is important so you can reasonably hit 3-star without rolling much before 7.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::once you reach level 7 on 3-5 for tempo or 4-1 when you need gold but have hp, start rolling for 7 riftbeast + 3-star krug, scuttle, cinderling, and pebbles. sometimes you can play around murkwolf or gromp if you have many items. thief's gloves can be good for unitemized 3-stars.
tasks.en: Once you reach Level 7 on 3-5 for tempo or 4-1 when you need gold but have HP, start rolling for 7 Riftbeast + 3-star Krug, Scuttle, Cinderling, and Pebbles. Sometimes you can play around Murkwolf or Gromp if you have many items. Thief's Gloves can be good for unitemized 3-stars.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::once you hit 3-star krug, focus on pushing levels so you can ideally play around elder dragon late game.
tasks.en: Once you hit 3-star Krug, focus on pushing levels so you can ideally play around Elder Dragon late game.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the comp can be played as fast 9 in rare circumstances where you streak with nearly a natural cinderling or pebbles 3, but this is quite rare so the reroll variant is far more popular.
tasks.en: The comp can be played as fast 9 in rare circumstances where you streak with nearly a natural Cinderling or Pebbles 3, but this is quite rare so the reroll variant is far more popular.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::most of the time alpha mark your carry (cinderling or pebbles) unless you need the frontline in which case you can mark scuttle (if krug usually dies later) or krug (if he is dying quick enough). tank alpha mark becomes better later in the game.
tasks.en: Most of the time Alpha Mark your carry (Cinderling or Pebbles) unless you need the frontline in which case you can mark Scuttle (if Krug usually dies later) or Krug (if he is dying quick enough). Tank Alpha Mark becomes better later in the game.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::item priority matrix was changed in 18.4 to reflect the fact that pebbles has become the better 1-cost to play around than cinderling. obviously the priority shifts depending on which of these 1-costs you are prioritizing items on. right now ap items for pebbles are better.
tasks.en: Item Priority matrix was changed in 18.4 to reflect the fact that Pebbles has become the better 1-cost to play around than Cinderling. Obviously the priority shifts depending on which of these 1-costs you are prioritizing items on. Right now AP items for Pebbles are better.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::if you are playing around itemized pebbles, the late-game board can shift slightly. cinderling + scuttle can be dropped for elder. gromp + kog'maw is sometimes played late-game. there are more options now if you can put your ad items on elder dragon.
tasks.en: If you are playing around itemized Pebbles, the late-game board can shift slightly. Cinderling + Scuttle can be dropped for Elder. Gromp + Kog'Maw is sometimes played late-game. There are more options now if you can put your AD items on Elder Dragon.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::malphite and rek'sai are not mandatory, although it is the most common version of the board. can also just play around upgraded frontline like sett, sentinel, or taric
tasks.en: Malphite and Rek'Sai are not mandatory, although it is the most common version of the board. Can also just play around upgraded frontline like Sett, Sentinel, or Taric

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::pick tiger for primal blessing. previous consensus was that bear is best, but now tiger is becoming more popular
tasks.en: Pick Tiger for Primal Blessing. Previous consensus was that Bear is best, but now Tiger is becoming more popular

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not add solar until either level 7 or level 8. 3 solar is likely better on 7 if you have five 3-stars, but 3 executioner is probably better if you have fewer than that. not known though. always play 3 solar on 8.
tasks.en: Do not add Solar until either Level 7 or Level 8. 3 Solar is likely better on 7 if you have five 3-stars, but 3 Executioner is probably better if you have fewer than that. Not known though. Always play 3 Solar on 8.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::do not waste bench space / gold holding onto leona and kayle long before you are able to level. it is almost never worth losing a gold interval to hold these units unless you are close to leveling (done rerolling) and adding them.
tasks.en: Do not waste bench space / gold holding onto Leona and Kayle long before you are able to level. It is almost never worth losing a gold interval to hold these units unless you are close to leveling (done rerolling) and adding them.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::aim for five 3-stars for the solar bonus.
tasks.en: Aim for five 3-stars for the Solar bonus.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::roll deeper when you are close to leblanc 3 because she has a higher chance of printing units on your board when 3-starred
tasks.en: Roll deeper when you are close to LeBlanc 3 because she has a higher chance of printing units on your board when 3-starred

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::if you have kha'zix in your pool, move yorick or leona in front of the kha'zix so he doesn't walk up to your frontline. failure to do this can result in losing your backline very quickly.
tasks.en: If you have Kha'Zix in your pool, move Yorick or Leona in front of the Kha'Zix so he doesn't walk up to your frontline. Failure to do this can result in losing your backline very quickly.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the "main" board is the most common end board, but you can play around ahri, ezreal, or even nidalee if you struggle to hit the standard board. 2 flora fatalis is always ideal so you can get healing procs on malphite.
tasks.en: The "Main" board is the most common end board, but you can play around Ahri, Ezreal, or even Nidalee if you struggle to hit the standard board. 2 Flora Fatalis is always ideal so you can get healing procs on Malphite.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::antiheal items are not necessary thanks to inferno units
tasks.en: Antiheal items are not necessary thanks to Inferno units

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp has high winout potential, but requires itemized kennen to winout. if you hit kennen on level 8, immediately replace shen. the reason item augments are so good in this line is because in an ideal world, you itemize malphite + soraka + zyra + kennen in the end game.
tasks.en: This comp has high winout potential, but requires itemized Kennen to winout. If you hit Kennen on Level 8, immediately replace Shen. The reason item augments are so good in this line is because in an ideal world, you itemize Malphite + Soraka + Zyra + Kennen in the end game.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::zyra is a better carry than soraka. prioritize itemizing her over soraka. in general, soraka is the weakest of the ap item holders for this line. she's better at 2-star than 1-star carries, but otherwise generally itemize her last.
tasks.en: Zyra is a better carry than Soraka. Prioritize itemizing her over Soraka. In general, Soraka is the weakest of the AP item holders for this line. She's better at 2-star than 1-star carries, but otherwise generally itemize her last.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::seraphim's staff augment is very strong if you can get 2 archangel's on zyra.
tasks.en: Seraphim's Staff augment is very strong if you can get 2 Archangel's on Zyra.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the main issues with this line are the fact it wants to hit alune on level 8 and the fact that it can't cap that high, but its main strength is that it is one of the cheaper boards and therefore can be played with more item and combat augments than other fast 8 lines.
tasks.en: The main issues with this line are the fact it wants to hit Alune on Level 8 and the fact that it can't cap that high, but its main strength is that it is one of the cheaper boards and therefore can be played with more item and combat augments than other fast 8 lines.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::emblems generally aren't that great for this line because the board is relatively inflexible. if you only have 1 emblem, such as spellweaver, it's typically better to just play the same board than try to make substitutions
tasks.en: Emblems generally aren't that great for this line because the board is relatively inflexible. If you only have 1 Emblem, such as Spellweaver, it's typically better to just play the same board than try to make substitutions

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::utility items are best on teemo over leblanc until you can eventually get to morgana on level 8. even on level 8, you would only move them to morgana if alistar, teemo, and leblanc all have 3 items.
tasks.en: Utility items are best on Teemo over LeBlanc until you can eventually get to Morgana on Level 8. Even on Level 8, you would only move them to Morgana if Alistar, Teemo, and LeBlanc all have 3 items.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::dig below 50g for leblanc if you are close as 3-star leblanc has higher odds of cloning units on your board. how deep you should roll depends on your hp and how close you are to hitting the entire board, but going to 30g with 7 leblancs and 20g with 8 leblancs is reasonable
tasks.en: Dig below 50g for LeBlanc if you are close as 3-star LeBlanc has higher odds of cloning units on your board. How deep you should roll depends on your HP and how close you are to hitting the entire board, but going to 30g with 7 LeBlancs and 20g with 8 LeBlancs is reasonable

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp was practically unplayable before patch 18.5, but now is viable after buffs to both tristana and 4 fae. the comp is much better with fae emblem still as it allows you to drop xayah for rengar which is a major spike.
tasks.en: This comp was practically unplayable before Patch 18.5, but now is viable after buffs to both Tristana and 4 Fae. The comp is much better with Fae Emblem still as it allows you to drop Xayah for Rengar which is a major spike.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::4 fae and rengar provide a lot of gold over the course of the game so while econ augments are still important for hitting, it is perfectly acceptable to prioritize item augments to ensure all your carries can get itemized as soon as possible (especially rengar for farming kills).
tasks.en: 4 Fae and Rengar provide a lot of gold over the course of the game so while econ augments are still important for hitting, it is perfectly acceptable to prioritize item augments to ensure all your carries can get itemized as soon as possible (especially Rengar for farming kills).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::for the opener, you can just play rengar + frontline. it doesn't matter what the frontline is, although it is ideal if you play around units that make the final board.
tasks.en: For the opener, you can just play Rengar + Frontline. It doesn't matter what the frontline is, although it is ideal if you play around units that make the final board.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::general kha'zix upgrade order is ravager > executioner or spellweaver > rapidfire. executioner is better than spellweaver if you have an executioner.
tasks.en: General Kha'Zix upgrade order is Ravager > Executioner or Spellweaver > Rapidfire. Executioner is better than Spellweaver if you have an Executioner.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::avoid playing from spots where you can't itemize either rengar or kha'zix early as the early takedowns help this comp stay on tempo.
tasks.en: Avoid playing from spots where you can't itemize either Rengar or Kha'Zix early as the early takedowns help this comp stay on tempo.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::gargoyle can be difficult to build in this line due to how important edge of night and titan's are. it's fine if you can't build gargoyle. edge of night on both carries and titans on rengar is more important
tasks.en: Gargoyle can be difficult to build in this line due to how important Edge of Night and Titan's are. It's fine if you can't build Gargoyle. Edge of Night on both carries and Titans on Rengar is more important

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::last whisper is better than evenshroud, but the reality is it's much harder to build because the first two bow's in this line almost always go to rageblade + titan's. red buff is also better than last whisper since evenshroud is easier to build than sunfire (due to how important chains are).
tasks.en: Last Whisper is better than Evenshroud, but the reality is it's much harder to build because the first two Bow's in this line almost always go to Rageblade + Titan's. Red Buff is also better than Last Whisper since Evenshroud is easier to build than Sunfire (due to how important Chains are).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::the end result is this: sometimes it's hard to get hecarim tanky enough to solo frontline because you can't afford to build gargoyle on him or you have to put evenshroud on him. in cases like these, consider a more traditional positioning like the one in "weak hecarim" variation.
tasks.en: The end result is this: Sometimes it's hard to get Hecarim tanky enough to solo frontline because you can't afford to build Gargoyle on him or you have to put Evenshroud on him. In cases like these, consider a more traditional positioning like the one in "Weak Hecarim" variation.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::generally it is better to itemize rengar before kha'zix as he farms gold which helps hit the board.
tasks.en: Generally it is better to itemize Rengar before Kha'Zix as he farms gold which helps hit the board.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::backline utility items are better than frontline ones (as usual for this set) and aphelios doesn't need rageblade, so red buff is ideal. but frontline tank items are more useable in this line than others, so just prioritize having utility.
tasks.en: Backline utility items are better than frontline ones (as usual for this set) and Aphelios doesn't need Rageblade, so Red Buff is ideal. But frontline tank items are more useable in this line than others, so just prioritize having utility.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::this comp appears to be a heavy roll on level 8 comp as the level 9 slot is not as impactful. only go level 9 after hitting your itemized 4-costs.
tasks.en: This comp appears to be a heavy roll on Level 8 comp as the Level 9 slot is not as impactful. Only go level 9 after hitting your itemized 4-costs.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::brambleback is not mandatory. can play around morgana or zyra as duo carry instead if you have ap items or do not have proper bramble items. play the "no brambleback" variation and itemize either morgana or zyra as duo on 8 (morgana better).
tasks.en: Brambleback is NOT mandatory. Can play around Morgana or Zyra as duo carry instead if you have AP items or do not have proper Bramble items. Play the "No Brambleback" variation and itemize either Morgana or Zyra as duo on 8 (Morgana better).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::veigar is a permanently stacking champion so try to avoid playing this line from weak openers.
tasks.en: Veigar is a permanently stacking champion so try to avoid playing this line from weak openers.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::since the comp revolves around veigar, there are some important item conditions to be aware of that make the line much stronger. check the strong conditions section and builds for veigar.
tasks.en: Since the comp revolves around Veigar, there are some important item conditions to be aware of that make the line much stronger. Check the Strong Conditions section and Builds for Veigar.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::there are two consuming flora augments in the strong conditions section because one of them is offered on 2-1 and one is offered on 3-2. the one offered on 2-1 is stronger because it allows you to itemize and stack veigar earlier.
tasks.en: There are two Consuming Flora augments in the Strong Conditions section because one of them is offered on 2-1 and one is offered on 3-2. The one offered on 2-1 is stronger because it allows you to itemize and stack Veigar earlier.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::malphite 2 is a stronger tank than rek'sai 3 if you randomly hit him. can consider playing around 4 blackthorn if you do hit a random malphite 2 (see the executioner board as an example).
tasks.en: Malphite 2 is a stronger tank than Rek'Sai 3 if you randomly hit him. Can consider playing around 4 Blackthorn if you do hit a random Malphite 2 (see the Executioner board as an example).

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::warwick's ability gives him stacking attack speed each time he casts and his cast speed scales with attack speed. this means shojin is one of his best items and generally his build is less flexible than most units.
tasks.en: Warwick's ability gives him stacking attack speed each time he casts and his cast speed scales with attack speed. This means Shojin is one of his best items and generally his build is less flexible than most units.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::acceptable to play around rek'sai 3 as tank over malphite 1 since hitting malphite 2 can be difficult at times. consider holding extra copies while going for warwick / murkwolf.
tasks.en: Acceptable to play around Rek'Sai 3 as tank over Malphite 1 since hitting Malphite 2 can be difficult at times. Consider holding extra copies while going for Warwick / Murkwolf.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::most important yunara items are shojin and deathblade.
tasks.en: Most important Yunara items are Shojin and Deathblade.

tasks.id: economy::comp-tip::backline utility items are better than tank utility items. can use last whisper on yunara before eventually moving to ezreal after getting a 3rd yunara item.
tasks.en: Backline utility items are better than tank utility items. Can use Last Whisper on Yunara before eventually moving to Ezreal after getting a 3rd Yunara item.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::lower levels give the highest odds for low-cost units. leveling early dilutes that pool, so each copy takes more rolls to find.
tasks.en: Lower levels give the highest odds for low-cost units. Leveling early dilutes that pool, so each copy takes more rolls to find.
tasks.vi: Ở cấp độ thấp, tỉ lệ xuất hiện tướng giá thấp cao hơn. Lên cấp quá sớm làm loãng bể tướng, khiến bạn cần roll nhiều hơn để tìm từng bản sao.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::the moment your carries hit 3 stars, flip the switch: spend down and push levels to stabilize.
tasks.en: The moment your carries hit 3 stars, flip the switch: spend down and push levels to stabilize.
tasks.vi: Ngay khi chủ lực lên 3 sao, hãy đổi chiến thuật: dùng vàng và đẩy cấp để ổn định đội hình.
Chưa mua XP trước khi hoàn thành tướng 3 sao.

tasks.id: tips::article-list-item::push levels only after the target is secured.
tasks.en: Push levels only after the target is secured.
tasks.vi: Chỉ đẩy cấp sau khi đã đạt mục tiêu.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::move center when the carry has aoe needing coverage, or opponents park divers for your corner.
tasks.en: Move center when the carry has AoE needing coverage, or opponents park divers for your corner.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::squishy units in front of a carry are not protection: they evaporate and focus walks through.
tasks.en: Squishy units in front of a carry are not protection: they evaporate and focus walks through.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::scouting tells whether to spend: a countered board needs gold now, a free matchup can greed.
tasks.en: Scouting tells whether to spend: a countered board needs gold now, a free matchup can greed.

tasks.vi: Chỉ cần để ý những người chơi được đánh dấu.

tasks.id: tips::article-list-item::scout right before the round locks.
tasks.en: Scout right before the round locks.
tasks.vi: Trinh sát ngay trước khi vòng đấu khóa đối thủ.
Bạn không thể gặp lại những đối thủ vừa chạm trán.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::know each carry fallback item so there is always something safe to build.
tasks.en: Know each carry fallback item so there is always something safe to build.
tasks.vi: Nắm rõ trang bị thay thế cho từng chủ lực để luôn có lựa chọn ghép đồ an toàn.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::wound does not stack. the second source is always the wrong item.
tasks.en: Wound does not stack. The second source is always the wrong item.
tasks.vi: Hiệu ứng Vết Thương Sâu không cộng dồn. Ghép thêm nguồn Vết Thương Sâu thứ hai thường là lựa chọn trang bị sai.

tasks.id: tips::article-paragraph::contesting is fine when ahead on gold, hp or augments, or when the line supports two or three players. otherwise pivot free.
tasks.en: Contesting is fine when ahead on gold, HP or augments, or when the line supports two or three players. Otherwise pivot free.
tasks.vi: Tranh bài vẫn ổn nếu bạn đang dẫn trước về vàng, máu hoặc Nâng Cấp, hoặc đội hình đó đủ sức cho 2–3 người chơi cùng sử dụng. Nếu không, hãy xoay bài sang hướng ít bị tranh.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::morgana holds utility items. you can tank either sentinel or sett. best emblem = invoker on ahri. late game cap with ashe + alune over karma.
tasks.en: Morgana holds utility items. You can tank either Sentinel or Sett. Best emblem = Invoker on Ahri. Late game cap with Ashe + Alune over Karma.

tasks.id: comps::comp-stage::look for 3 blossom early and play for win streak. karma can hold items for ahri. itemize yorick or any other 2* tank.
tasks.en: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.

tasks.id: comps::comp-stage::flex in more blossom or spellweavers as you get them. you can tank all kinds of frontline: juggernauts, defenders, or vanguards.
tasks.en: Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.

tasks.id: comps::comp-stage::level and roll for ahri, morgana, and the frontline. once stable, go level 9 for lux.
tasks.en: Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::play when you hit zyra 2 on your ahri rolldown instead of morgana. play 5 blossom on level 8 with karma+1 then try to go 9 for the 5 costs, itemize alune 2 lategame.
tasks.en: Play when you hit Zyra 2 on your Ahri rolldown instead of Morgana. Play 5 blossom on level 8 with Karma+1 then try to go 9 for the 5 costs, itemize alune 2 lategame.

tasks.id: comps::comp-stage::flex in more spellweavers + frontline as you get them. you can tank all kinds of frontline: juggernauts, defenders, or vanguards.
tasks.en: Flex in more Spellweavers + frontline as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.

tasks.id: comps::comp-stage::level and roll for ahri, zyra, and the 4 spellweavers. play cassio or leblanc until you find alune.
tasks.en: Level and roll for Ahri, Zyra, and the 4 Spellweavers. Play Cassio or LeBlanc until you find Alune.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::cap the board with a lux over morgana for end game. lunar lux is best but play whatever lux you are likely to 2* first. carry / tank 4 cost units until you get to the end game. always focus on unit quality over exact board units.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::kha'zix only needs to get executioner in this line before you start sacrificing him to the blackthorn hex. that is part of what makes this line unique: because it plays around azir carry with a non-blackthorn tank, you can sacrifice an ap unit instead of tank unit. this means you can play this line even if you do not have early kha'zix copies. most people do not reroll kha'zix unless they have him in stage 2, so make sure to scout early to ensure you are uncontested. at 3 stars, sacrificing kha'zix provides azir over 40% damage amp and 6 mana per second so focus on giving azir gunblade, ap items, and attack speed. striker's is an acceptable damage amp item because it gives crit. sacrificing kha'zix also means you don't technically need rageblade. it's still a good item when paired with rabadon's or archangel, but because azir has an additional 6 mana per second he will still cast often and his cast gives him 150% attack speed. this means ideally every azir build has gunblade + rabadon's or archangel, but the 3rd item is relatively flexible. void staff is ideal because it is a great azir item before you can get 3 full proper items on him. if you have to build ionic spark instead, try to get into a place where it goes onto sett instead of vi (always aim to have 3 "real" tank items on vi). it's better to play void on azir than spark on vi since zyra is the best holder of utility and secondary carry items, it's possible that it's better to play zyra over sett on level 7. be flexible based on your items and frontline needs.
tasks.en: Kha'Zix only needs to get Executioner in this line before you start sacrificing him to the Blackthorn hex. That is part of what makes this line unique: Because it plays around Azir carry with a non-Blackthorn tank, you can sacrifice an AP unit instead of tank unit. This means you can play this line even if you do not have early Kha'Zix copies. Most people do not reroll Kha'Zix unless they have him in Stage 2, so make sure to scout early to ensure you are uncontested. At 3 stars, sacrificing Kha'Zix provides Azir over 40% damage amp and 6 mana per second so focus on giving Azir Gunblade, AP items, and Attack Speed. Striker's is an acceptable damage amp item because it gives crit. Sacrificing Kha'Zix also means you don't technically need Rageblade. It's still a good item when paired with Rabadon's or Archangel, but because Azir has an additional 6 mana per second he will still cast often and his cast gives him 150% Attack Speed. This means ideally every Azir build has Gunblade + Rabadon's or Archangel, but the 3rd item is relatively flexible. Void Staff is ideal because it is a great Azir item before you can get 3 full proper items on him. If you have to build Ionic Spark instead, try to get into a place where it goes onto Sett instead of Vi (always aim to have 3 "real" tank items on Vi). It's better to play Void on Azir than Spark on Vi Since Zyra is the best holder of utility and secondary carry items, it's possible that it's better to play Zyra over Sett on level 7. Be flexible based on your items and frontline needs.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::the main board is 5 blossom + juggernaut + brawler + 2 flex slots. vi + sivir + zyra is common, but can also play maokai over vi and zyra can be replaced with ivern or lux. sivir is not as important if not playing around vi. this comp is flexible on emblems thanks to the flexible unit slots. blossom emblem is strong because it allows you to play 7 blossom on 8 consistently even without ahri. the extra gold from 7 blossom helps you hit the full board and go 9. 5 blossom boards tend to cap higher than 7 blossom boards since the primary benefit of 7 blossom is the extra gold. play 7 blossom as long as possible, then look to move out of 7 blossom late game once you need to stabilize. position ahri on the same side as the opponent's carry. much of the strength of this comp comes from the fact that ahri can kill the opponent's backline before their tank. ahri's ability to kill the backline is part of why having perfect items on her and 2 starring her as soon as possible are important. it helps give her enough damage to ensure she can kill the backline rather than leave them barely alive. part of why executioner emblem is so good for this line is because it helps ahri meet the threshold killing backline by giving her an execute and it enables playing kennen which also helps kill the backline.
tasks.en: The main board is 5 Blossom + Juggernaut + Brawler + 2 Flex Slots. Vi + Sivir + Zyra is common, but can also play Maokai over Vi and Zyra can be replaced with Ivern or Lux. Sivir is not as important if not playing around Vi. This comp is flexible on Emblems thanks to the flexible unit slots. Blossom Emblem is strong because it allows you to play 7 Blossom on 8 consistently even without Ahri. The extra gold from 7 Blossom helps you hit the full board and go 9. 5 Blossom boards tend to cap higher than 7 Blossom boards since the primary benefit of 7 Blossom is the extra gold. Play 7 Blossom as long as possible, then look to move out of 7 Blossom late game once you need to stabilize. Position Ahri on the same side as the opponent's carry. Much of the strength of this comp comes from the fact that Ahri can kill the opponent's backline before their tank. Ahri's ability to kill the backline is part of why having perfect items on her and 2 starring her as soon as possible are important. It helps give her enough damage to ensure she can kill the backline rather than leave them barely alive. Part of why Executioner Emblem is so good for this line is because it helps Ahri meet the threshold killing backline by giving her an execute AND it enables playing Kennen which also helps kill the backline.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::this is a comp that was played during pbe, but no longer played as riftbeasts vertical is generally just better. can consider playing from worth the wait pebbles, otherwise play other lines. this is primary reason for d-tier ranking. while you can play around 5 riftbeast for the shops before hitting pebbles 3, the best endgame board appears to be 5 invoker which helps pebbles go infinite. this comp can use many tears, so always almost always prioritize them on carousel. pebbles needs ~17.1 mana regen (round up to 18) + alpha mark to go infinite. going infinite does not look mandatory, but it is worth noting. double mana allows for sentinel alpha mark and can still go infinite (need 2 sentinel casts with 21 regen+). if you build double mana on pebbles (blue + blue or blue + adaptive), the last item really wants to be rabadon's or pebbles will not do enough damage. alpha mark is not solved for this line. current theory i have is this: below 17 mana regen use it on sentinel or scuttle. between 17 and 20 use on pebbles for infinite cast. from 21 to 23, use on sentinel for infinite cast + teamwide regen. it's possible scuttle is always better. all the mana values mentioned here are for 70 max mana and 35% mana drain per second, so verify against pebble's tooltip in case these tips go out of date.
tasks.en: This is a comp that was played during PBE, but no longer played as Riftbeasts vertical is generally just better. Can consider playing from Worth the Wait Pebbles, otherwise play other lines. This is primary reason for D-tier ranking. While you can play around 5 Riftbeast for the shops before hitting Pebbles 3, the best endgame board appears to be 5 Invoker which helps Pebbles go infinite. This comp can use many tears, so always almost always prioritize them on Carousel. Pebbles needs ~17.1 Mana Regen (round up to 18) + Alpha Mark to go infinite. Going infinite does not look mandatory, but it is worth noting. Double mana allows for Sentinel Alpha Mark and can still go infinite (need 2 Sentinel casts with 21 regen+). If you build double mana on Pebbles (Blue + Blue or Blue + Adaptive), the last item really wants to be Rabadon's or Pebbles will not do enough damage. Alpha Mark is not solved for this line. Current theory I have is this: Below 17 mana regen use it on Sentinel or Scuttle. Between 17 and 20 use on Pebbles for infinite cast. From 21 to 23, use on Sentinel for infinite cast + teamwide regen. It's possible Scuttle is always better. All the mana values mentioned here are for 70 Max Mana and 35% Mana Drain per second, so verify against Pebble's tooltip in case these tips go out of date.

tasks.en: Roll to 33 gold, buying any unit that will be part of the level 4 or 5 board. You can also buy units that will be part of the level 6+ board, but you can sell those if your bench fills and you need to buy other units. Rolling to 33 gold is advisable because it allows you to save back up to 50g by 3-5.

tasks.en: Do not level if you haven't hit your 3-star 1-costs yet. If you have your 3-stars, you generally should still stay level 5 if you can win or if leveling to 6 would put you below 20g. Try to get above 40g this round.
tasks.vi: Đừng lên cấp nếu bạn chưa nâng được các tướng 1 vàng lên 3 sao. Nếu đã có tướng 3 sao, thường vẫn nên giữ cấp 5 nếu còn có thể thắng hoặc nếu lên cấp 6 khiến bạn còn dưới 20 vàng. Cố gắng tích trên 40 vàng trong vòng này.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::sacrifice either teemo or soraka to blackthorn hex. 3-star teemo is slightly more stats than 2-star soraka, but is more expensive so often it is better to just go for 2-star soraka on level 7 rather than 3-star teemo. sacrifice 2-star teemo over 1-star soraka. can drop teemo for gnar since you can always sacrifice soraka to the blackthorn hex. do not sacrifice gnar. late-game (stage 5+) you will ideally want fiddlesticks 3 in addition to rammus to hold down the frontline. there isn't much to level for on 8, so staying level 7 for hitting fiddle is reasonable if you are close. level 8 add an executioner, sentinel, lillia, yorick, or a random 5-cost like ivern. rageblade on azir is a good item, but not necessary. sacrificing an ap unit like teemo to blackthorn gives mana regen, meaning he will cast even without rageblade, but often the item is still solid for a tempo slam. prioritize other rod items over it though. one strong reason to play this over the vi blossom version is it fits better on level 7. the other version struggles to play zyra on level 7, so if you have a surplus of items, generally consider this line over vi + azir
tasks.en: Sacrifice either Teemo or Soraka to Blackthorn hex. 3-star Teemo is slightly more stats than 2-star Soraka, but is more expensive so often it is better to just go for 2-star Soraka on Level 7 rather than 3-star Teemo. Sacrifice 2-star Teemo over 1-star Soraka. Can drop Teemo for Gnar since you can always sacrifice Soraka to the Blackthorn hex. Do not sacrifice Gnar. Late-game (Stage 5+) you will ideally want Fiddlesticks 3 in addition to Rammus to hold down the frontline. There isn't much to level for on 8, so staying Level 7 for hitting Fiddle is reasonable if you are close. Level 8 add an Executioner, Sentinel, Lillia, Yorick, or a random 5-cost like Ivern. Rageblade on Azir is a good item, but not necessary. Sacrificing an AP unit like Teemo to Blackthorn gives Mana Regen, meaning he will cast even without Rageblade, but often the item is still solid for a tempo slam. Prioritize other Rod items over it though. One strong reason to play this over the Vi Blossom version is it fits better on Level 7. The other version struggles to play Zyra on Level 7, so if you have a surplus of items, generally consider this line over Vi + Azir

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::rapidfire emblem is mandatory for this line. the spike from 4 to 5 rapidfire is huge and it is a strong item on brambleback. do not build rageblade on aphelios. 5 rapidfire provides more than enough attack speed. aim for items that give ad, crit, or damage amp such as kraken, infinity edge, deathblade, giant slayer, or striker's. utility like red buff / last whisper or gunblade are fine too. note that this line plays inferno, so red buff is not important on aphelios like it is in the other aphelios comps. sunder is still important. diana or taric is played on level 9. can also drop rakan for maokai on 9 once you play either diana or taric. taric is better than diana if same star level. diana 2 is probably slightly better than taric 1. do not drop 5 rapidfire for 4 vanguard. prioritize itemizing whoever is upgraded first between amumu and sentinel. if both are upgraded or 1 star, prioritize itemizing amumu.
tasks.en: Rapidfire Emblem is mandatory for this line. The spike from 4 to 5 Rapidfire is huge and it is a strong item on Brambleback. Do not build Rageblade on Aphelios. 5 Rapidfire provides more than enough attack speed. Aim for items that give AD, crit, or damage amp such as Kraken, Infinity Edge, Deathblade, Giant Slayer, or Striker's. Utility like Red Buff / Last Whisper or Gunblade are fine too. Note that this line plays Inferno, so Red Buff is not important on Aphelios like it is in the other Aphelios comps. Sunder is still important. Diana or Taric is played on Level 9. Can also drop Rakan for Maokai on 9 once you play either Diana or Taric. Taric is better than Diana if same star level. Diana 2 is probably slightly better than Taric 1. Do not drop 5 Rapidfire for 4 Vanguard. Prioritize itemizing whoever is upgraded first between Amumu and Sentinel. If both are upgraded or 1 star, prioritize itemizing Amumu.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::for sunder, last whisper on mama beak is strong as an alternative to evenshroud on hecarim. evenshroud looks slightly better though and bows are in high demand in this comp so most of the time you should build evenshroud over last whisper.
tasks.en: For Sunder, Last Whisper on Mama Beak is strong as an alternative to Evenshroud on Hecarim. Evenshroud looks slightly better though and Bows are in high demand in this comp so most of the time you should build Evenshroud over Last Whisper.

tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::play standard instead of reroll. do not need 5 riftbeast as early as reroll version because this line doesn't play around pebbles or cinderling 3. still want it by 3-1 though to get 3-5 riftbeast shop for ideally 7 riftbeast on 3-5. brambleback wants rageblade + edge of night + flexible 3rd item such as hoj, qss, bloodthirster, etc. combat augments are good because this version of riftbeasts aims to make brambleback go infinite at the end of the fight and the comp can usually hit its 4-costs thanks to 5 riftbeast. can play around sentinel 2 over krug 2 before hitting krug 3. it is acceptable to slight roll on level 7 for 7 riftbeast if you are likely to hit it as it is a major spike. ideally stay above 30g. whether this is correct will vary by game and when your riftbeast shop is.
tasks.en: Play standard instead of reroll. Do not need 5 Riftbeast as early as reroll version because this line doesn't play around Pebbles or Cinderling 3. Still want it by 3-1 though to get 3-5 Riftbeast shop for ideally 7 Riftbeast on 3-5. Brambleback wants Rageblade + Edge of Night + Flexible 3rd item such as HoJ, QSS, Bloodthirster, etc. Combat augments are good because this version of Riftbeasts aims to make Brambleback go infinite at the end of the fight and the comp can usually hit its 4-costs thanks to 5 Riftbeast. Can play around Sentinel 2 over Krug 2 before hitting Krug 3. It is acceptable to slight roll on Level 7 for 7 Riftbeast if you are likely to hit it as it is a major spike. Ideally stay above 30g. tasks.en: Use 5 Riftbeast shops to finish your 3* because you want to rush 7 Riftbeast on Level 7 ASAP. You can carry ALL of the riftbeast carries besides Mama Beak if you have items. tasks.en: Core is Malphite + Azir + 2 Flora Fatalis for healing. Play Ezreal or Zyra depending on items, it's not worth to play both usually compared to more frontline. tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::the "main" board is the most common end board, but you can play around ahri, ezreal, or even nidalee if you struggle to hit the standard board. 2 flora fatalis is always ideal so you can get healing procs on malphite. antiheal items are not necessary thanks to inferno units this comp has high winout potential, but requires itemized kennen to winout. if you hit kennen on level 8, immediately replace shen. the reason item augments are so good in this line is because in an ideal world, you itemize malphite + soraka + zyra + kennen in the end game. zyra is a better carry than soraka. prioritize itemizing her over soraka. in general, soraka is the weakest of the ap item holders for this line. she's better at 2-star than 1-star carries, but otherwise generally itemize her last. seraphim's staff augment is very strong if you can get 2 archangel's on zyra.
tasks.en: The "Main" board is the most common end board, but you can play around Ahri, Ezreal, or even Nidalee if you struggle to hit the standard board. 2 Flora Fatalis is always ideal so you can get healing procs on Malphite. tasks.id: comps::comp-tips::general kha'zix upgrade order is ravager > executioner or spellweaver > rapidfire. executioner is better than spellweaver if you have an executioner. avoid playing from spots where you can't itemize either rengar or kha'zix early as the early takedowns help this comp stay on tempo. gargoyle can be difficult to build in this line due to how important edge of night and titan's are. it's fine if you can't build gargoyle. edge of night on both carries and titans on rengar is more important last whisper is better than evenshroud, but the reality is it's much harder to build because the first two bow's in this line almost always go to rageblade + titan's. red buff is also better than last whisper since evenshroud is easier to build than sunfire (due to how important chains are). the end result is this: sometimes it's hard to get hecarim tanky enough to solo frontline because you can't afford to build gargoyle on him or you have to put evenshroud on him. in cases like these, consider a more traditional positioning like the one in "weak hecarim" variation. generally it is better to itemize rengar before kha'zix as he farms gold which helps hit the board.
tasks.en: General Kha'Zix upgrade order is Ravager > Executioner or Spellweaver > Rapidfire. Executioner is better than Spellweaver if you have an Executioner. Avoid playing from spots where you can't itemize either Rengar or Kha'Zix early as the early takedowns help this comp stay on tempo. Gargoyle can be difficult to build in this line due to how important Edge of Night and Titan's are. It's fine if you can't build Gargoyle. Edge of Night on both carries and Titans on Rengar is more important Last Whisper is better than Evenshroud, but the reality is it's much harder to build because the first two Bow's in this line almost always go to Rageblade + Titan's. Red Buff is also better than Last Whisper since Evenshroud is easier to build than Sunfire (due to how important Chains are). The end result is this: Sometimes it's hard to get Hecarim tanky enough to solo frontline because you can't afford to build Gargoyle on him or you have to put Evenshroud on him. In cases like these, consider a more traditional positioning like the one in "Weak Hecarim" variation. Generally it is better to itemize Rengar before Kha'Zix as he farms gold which helps hit the board.
